a: Beserugin.

Nikanor naasu nissim ledaltotav. tanu rabbanan: ma nissim naasu ledaltotav? amru: keshehalach nikanor lehavi delatot mealekkesanderiyya shel mitzrayim, bachazirato amad alav nachshol shebbayyam letabbeo, natlu achat mehen vehetiluha layyam, vaadayin la nach hayyam mizzapo.

Bikkeshu lehatil et chavertah, amad hu ucherachah, amar lahem: hatiluni immah. miyyad nach hayyam mizzapo, vehaya mitztaer al chavertah. kevan shehiggia linmelah shel akko, hayta mevatzbetzet veyotza mittachat dofne hassefina. veyesh omrim beriyya shebbayyam belaatta, vehekiatta layyabbasha.

Vealeha amar shelomo: "korot battenu arazim rahitenu berotim", al tikre "berotim", ella "berit yam". lefichach, kol hashshearim shehayu bammikdash nishtannu lihyot shel zahav, chutz mishshaare nikanor mippene shennaasu bo nissim. veyesh omrim: mippene shennechoshtan mutzehevet hayta. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: nechoshet kelonita hayta, vehayta meira keshel zahav.
Mishna veellu lignay: shel bet garmu lo ratzu lelammed al maase lechem happanim, shel bet avtinas lo ratzu lelammed al maase hakketoret.

Hugeras ben levi haya yodea perek bashshir velo ratza lelammed, ben kamtzar lo ratza lelammed al maase hakketav. al harishonim neemar: "zecher tzaddik livracha", veal ellu neemar: "veshem reshaim yirkav".

Gemara tanu rabbanan: bet garmu hayu bekiin bemaase lechem happanim velo ratzu lelammed. shalchu chachamim veheviu ummanin mealekkesanderiyya shel mitzrayim. vehayu yodin leefot kemotan, velo hayu yodin lirdot kemotan. shehallalu massikin mibbachutz veofin mibbachutz, vehallalu massikin mibbifnim veofin mibbifnim. hallalu pittan mitappeshet, vehallalu en pittan mitappeshet.

Kesheshshamu chachamim baddavar, amru: kol ma shebbara hakkadosh baruch hu lichvodo berao, shenneemar: "kol hannikra vishmi velichvodi berativ". vechazru bet garmu limkoman. shalchu lahem chachamim — velo bau, kaflu lahem secharan uvau. bechol yom hayu notlin shenem asar mane, vehayyom esrim vearbaa. rabbi yehuda omer: bechol yom esrim vearbaa, vehayyom arbaim ushemona.

Amru lahem chachamim: ma reitem shello lelammed? amru lahem: yodin hayu shel bet abba shebbayit ze atid lecharev, shemma yilmod adam sheeno mehuggan veyelech veyaavod avoda zara bechach. veal davar ze mazkirin otan leshevach: meolam lo nimtzet pat nekiyya beyad benehem, shello yomru mimmaase lechem happanim ze nizzonin, lekayyem ma shenneemar: "vihyitem nekiyyim meAdonai umiyyisrael".

Shel bet avtinas lo ratzu lelammed al maase hakketoret. tanu rabbanan: bet avtinas hayu bekiin bemaase hakketoret velo ratzu lelammed, shalchu chachamim veheviu ummanin mealekkesanderiyya shel mitzrayim. vehayu yodin lefattem kemotam velo hayu yodin lehaalot ashan kemotan. shel hallalu — mittammer veole kemakkel, shel hallalu — maftzia lechan ulechan.

Uchesheshshamu chachamim baddavar, amru: kol ma shebbara hakkadosh baruch hu — lichvodo berao, shenneemar: "kol paal Adonai lammaanehu", vechazru bet avtinas limkoman. shalchu lahem chachamim velo bau, kaflu lahem secharan uvau. bechol yom hayu notlin shenem asar mane, vehayyom esrim vearbaa. rabbi yehuda omer: bechol yom esrim vearbaa, vehayyom arbaim ushemona.

Amru lahem chachamim: ma reitem shello lelammed? amru: yodin hayu shel bet abba shebbayit ze atid lecharev, amru: shemma yilmod adam sheeno mehuggan veyelech veyaavod avoda zara bechach. veal davar ze mazkirin otan leshevach: meolam lo yatzat kalla mevussemet mibbattehen, ucheshennosin ishsha mimmakom acher, matnin immah shello titbassem, shello yomru: mimmaase hakketoret mitbassemin, lekayyem ma shenneemar: "vihyitem nekiyyim meAdonai umiyyisrael".

Tanya, amar rabbi yishmael: paam achat hayiti mehallech badderech umatzati echad mibbene venehem, amarti lo: avotecha bikkeshu leharebot kevodan veratzu lemaet kevod hammakom, achshav kevod makom bimkomo, umiet kevodam.

Amar rabbi akiva: (paam achat) sach li rabbi yishmael ben loga: paam achat yatzati ani veechad mibbene venehem lassade lelakket asavim, veraiti (shessachak uvacha). amarti lo: mippene ma bachita? amar li: kevod avotay nizkarti. umippene ma sachakt? amar li: sheatid hakkadosh baruch hu lehachezirah lanu. umippene ma nizkarta? amar li: maale ashan kenegdi. hareehu li! amar li: shevua hi beyadenu sheen marin oto lechol adam.

Amar rabbi yochanan ben nuri: paam achat matzati zaken echad umegilat sammanin beyado. amarti lo: meayin atta? amar li: mibbet avtinas ani. uma beyadecha? amar li: megillat sammanin. hareehu li! amar li: kol zeman shebbet abba hayu kayyaymin, lo hayu mosrin oto lechol adam, veachshav hare hu lecha, vehizzaher bah. ucheshebbati vesachti devaray lifne rabbi akiva, amar li: meatta asur lesapper bignutan shel ellu.
Mikkan amar ben azzay: beshimcha yikrauch, uvimkomcha yoshivuch,
b: Umishshellecha yittenu lecha. en adam nogea bammuchan lachavero. veen malchut nogaat bachavertah afillu kimlo nima.
Hugeras ben levi vechulei. tanya: keshehu noten kolo binima, machnis gudalo letoch piv, umanniach etzbao ben hannimin, ad shehayu echav hakkohanim nizkarim bevat rosh laachorehem.

Tanu rabbanan: ben kamtzar lo ratza lelammed al maase hakketav. amru alav shehaya notel arbaa kulemosin ben etzbeotav, veim hayta teva shel arba otiyyot haya kotvah bevat achat. amru lo: ma raita shello lelammed? kullan matzu teshuva ledivrehem, ben kamtzar lo matza teshuva lidvarav. al harishonim neemar: "zecher tzaddik livracha", veal ben kamtzar vachaverav neemar: "veshem reshaim yirkav".

May "veshem reshaim yirkav"? amar rabbi elazar: rakbivut taale bishmotan, dela massekinan bishmayyhu. metiv ravina. maase bedoeg ben yosef, shehinnicho [aviv] ben katan leimmo. bechol yom hayta immo modadto bitfachim venotenet mishkalo shel zahav levet hammikdash, uchesheggavar oyev tevachattu vaachalattu.
Vealeha konen yirmeya: "im tochalna nashim piryam olle tippuchim", meshiva ruach hakkodesh veomeret: "im yehareg bemikdash Adonai kohen venavi", chazi may selek beh.
Amar rabbi elazar: tzaddik meatzmo, verasha mechavero. tzaddik meatzmo, dichtiv: "zecher tzaddik livracha", verasha mechavero, dichtiv: "veshem reshaim yirkav".

Amar leh ravina lehahu merabbanan dahava mesaddar aggadata kammeh: mena ha milleta daamur rabbanan "zecher tzaddik livracha"? amar leh, deha ketiv: "zecher tzaddik livracha"! middeorayyta mena lan? dichtiv: "vaAdonai amar hamechasse ani meavraham asher ani ose", uchetiv: "veavraham hayo yihye legoy gadol veatzum".

Mena ha milleta daamur rabbanan "shem reshaim yirkav"? amar leh, deha ketiv: "veshem reshaim yirkav". middeorayyta mena lan? dichtiv: "vayyeehal ad sedom", uchetiv: "veanshe sedom raim vechattaim laAdonai meod".

Amar rabbi elazar: tzaddik dar ben shene reshaim velo lamad mimmaasehem, rasha dar ben shene tzaddikim velo lamad mimmaasehem. tzaddik dar ben shene reshaim velo lamad mimmaasehem — ovadya. rasha dar ben shene tzaddikim velo lamad mimmaasehem — ze esav.

(Amar) rabbi elazar: mibbirchatan shel tzaddikim atta lamed kelala larshaim, umikkillatan shel reshaim atta lamed beracha latztzaddikim. mibbirchatan shel tzaddikim atta lamed kelala larshaim, dichtiv: "ki yedativ lemaan asher yetzavve vegomer", uchetiv batreh: "vayyomer Adonai zaakat sedom vaamora ki rabba".

Umikkillatan shel reshaim atta lamed beracha latztzaddikim, dichtiv: "veanshe sedom raim vechattaim laAdonai. vaAdonai amar el avram achare hippared lot meimmo". (amar) rabbi elazar: afillu bishvil tzaddik echad olam nivra, shenneemar: "vayyar elohim et haor ki tov", veen tov ella tzaddik, shenneemar: "imru tzaddik ki tov".

(Amar) rabbi elazar: kol hameshakkeach davar mittalmudo — gorem galut levanav, shenneemar: "vattishkach torat elohecha eshkach banecha gam ani". rabbi avahu amar: moridin oto miggedullato, shenneemar: "ki atta haddaat maasta veemascha mikkahen li".

Amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: en tzaddik niftar min haolam ad shennivra tzaddik kemoto, shenneemar: "vezarach hashshemesh uva hashshamesh". ad shello kavta shimsho shel eli, zarcha shimsho shel shemuel haramati. (amar) rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: raa hakkadosh baruch hu shetztzaddikim muatin, amad ushetalan bechol dor vador, shenneemar: "ki laAdonai metzuke eretz vayyashet alehem tevel".

(Amar) rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: afillu bishvil tzaddik echad haolam mitkayyem, shenneemar: "vetzaddik yesod olam". rabbi chiyyay dideh amar, mehacha: "ragle chasidav yishmor" — chasidav tuva mashma! amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: chasido ketiv.

(Amar) rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: kevan sheyyatzu rov shenotav shel adam velo chata — shuv eno chote, shenneemar: "ragle chasidav yishmor", deve rabbi shela amri: kevan shebbaa leyado devar avera paam rishona usheniyya veeno chote — shuv eno chote, shenneemar: "ragle chasidav yishmor".

Amar resh lakish, may dichtiv: "im lalletzim hu yalitz velaanavim yitten chen", ba littamme — potchin lo. ba littaher — mesayyeyin oto. tana deve rabbi yishmael: mashal leadam shehaya mocher neft vaafarsemon,

a: Ba limdod neft, omer lo: medod atta leatzmecha. ba limdod afarsemon, omer lo: hameten li ad sheemdod immecha, kede shennitbassem ani veatta.
Tana deve rabbi yishmael: avera metamtemet libbo shel adam, shenneemar: "velo tittammeu bahem venitmetem bam", al tikre "venitmetem", ella: "venittamtem".
Tanu rabbanan: "(al) tittammeu bahem venitmetem bam", adam metamme atzmo meat — metammein oto harebe. millematta — metammein oto millemala. baolam hazze — metammein oto laolam habba.
Tanu rabbanan: "vehitkaddishtem vihyitem kedoshim", adam mekaddesh atzmo meat — mekaddeshin oto harebe, millematta — mekaddeshin oto millemala, baolam hazze — mekaddeshin oto laolam habba.
Hadaran alach amar lahem hamemunne

Taraf bekalpi, veheela shene goralot, echad katuv alav "lashshem", veechad katuv alav "laazazel". hassegan bimino, verosh bet av missemolo. im shel shem ala bimino — hassegan omer lo: ishi kohen gadol, hageba yemincha. veim shel shem ala bismolo — rosh bet av omer lo: ishi kohen gadol, hageba semolcha.
Netanan al shene hasseirim, veomer: "laAdonai chattat". rabbi yishmael omer: lo haya tzarich lomar "chattat", ella "laAdonai". vehen onin acharav: "baruch shem kevod malchuto leolam vead".
Gemara lema li taraf bekalpi? ki hechi dela nikkavven velishkol.
Amar rava: kalpi shel etz hayta, veshel chol hayta, veenah machzeket ella shete yadayim.

Matkef la ravina: bishlama enah machzeket ella shete yadayim — ki hechi dela likkavven velishkol. ella shel chol? nakdesha! im ken have le keli sharet shel etz, ucheli sharet deetz la avdinan. venebeda dechesef, venebeda dezahav? hattora chasa al mamonan shel yisrael.

Matnitin dela ki hay tanna detanya, rabbi yehuda omer mishshum rabbi eliezer: hassegan vechohen gadol machnisin yadan bakkalpi, im bimino shel kohen gadol ole — hassegan omer lo: ishi kohen gadol, hageba yeminecha. veim bimino shel segan ole — rosh bet av omer lo lechohen gadol: dabber millach.
Venema leh segan? kevan dela salek bideh chalsha dateh.
Bemay ka mippalgi? mar savar: yammina disgan adif missemaleh dechohen gadol. umar savar: ki hadade ninhu.

Uman hay tanna diflig aleh derabbi yehuda — rabbi chanina segan hakkohanim hu. detanya, rabbi chanina segan hakkohanim omer: lamma segan mimino — sheim era bo pesul bechohen gadol, nichnas segan umeshammesh tachtav.

Tanu rabbanan: arbaim shana sheshshimmesh shimon hatztzaddik, haya goral ole beyamin. mikkan veelach, peamim ole beyamin peamim ole bismol. vehaya lashon shel zehorit malbin. mikkan veelach, peamim malbin peamim eno malbin. vehaya ner maaravi dolek. mikkan veelach, peamim dolek peamim kave.

Vehaya esh shel maaracha mitgabber, velo hayu kohanim tzerichin lehavi etzim lemaaracha, chutz mishshene gezire etzim kede lekayyem mitzvat etzim. mikkan veelach, peamim mitgabber peamim en mitgabber, velo hayu kohanim nimnain millehavi etzim lammaaracha kol hayyom kullo.

Venishtallecha beracha baomer, uvishte hallechem, uvelechem happanim. vechol kohen shemmaggio kezayit, yesh ochlo vesavea, veyesh ochlo umotir. mikkan veelach, nishtallecha meera baomer uvishte hallechem uvelechem happanim, vechol kohen maggio keful. hatztzenuin moshchin et yedehen, vehaggargeranin notlin veochlin. umaase beechad shennatal chelko vechelek chavero, vehayu korin oto "ben
b: Chamtzan" ad yom moto.

Amar rabba bar (bar) shela, may kera: "elohay palleteni miyyad rasha mikkaf meavvel vechometz". rava amar, mehacha: "limdu hetev dirshu mishpat ashsheru chamotz". oshro chamotz — veal taashru chometz.

Tanu rabbanan: otah shana shemmet bah shimon hatztzaddik, amar lahem: beshana zo hu met. amru lo: minnayin atta yodea? amar lahem: bechol yom hakkippurim haya mizdammen li zaken echad lavush levanim veatuf levanim, nichnas immi veyatza immi, vehayyom nizdammen li zaken echad lavush shechorim veatuf shechorim, nichnas immi velo yatza immi. achar haregel chala shiva yamim vamet.
Venimneu echav hakkohanim millevarech bashshem.
Tanu rabbanan: arbaim shana kodem chureban habbayit lo haya goral ole beyamin, velo haya lashon shel zehorit malbin, velo haya ner maaravi dolek.

Vehayu daltot hahechol niftechot mealehen, ad sheggaar bahen rabban yochanan ben zakkay. amar lo: hechol hechol! mippene ma atta mavit atzmecha? yodea ani becha shessofcha atid lecharev, uchevar nitnabbe alecha zecharya ben iddo: "petach levanon delatecha vetochal esh baarazecha",
Amar rabbi yitzchak ben tavlay: lamma nikra shemo levanon — shemmalbin avonotehen shel yisrael.

Amar rav zutera bar toviyya: lamma nikra shemo yaar, dichtiv: "bet yaar hallevanon", lomar lach: ma yaar melavlev — af bet hammikdash melavlev. deamar rav hoshaya: beshaa shebbana shelomo bet hammikdash, nata bo kol mine megadim shel zahav, vehayu motziin perot bizmannehen. vechevan sheharuach menashshevet bahen hayu noshrin perotehen, shenneemar: "yirash kallevanon piryo", umehen hayta parnasa lakkehunna.

Vechevan shennichnesu goyim lahechol yavshu, shenneemar: "uferach levanon umelal". veatid hakkadosh baruch hu lehachezirah lanu, shenneemar: "paroach tifrach vetagel af gilat verannen kevod hallevanon nittan lah".

Netanan al shene hasseirim. tanu rabbanan: eser peamim mazkir kohen gadol et hashshem bo bayyom: shelosha bevidduy rishon, ushelosha bevidduy sheni, ushelosha besair hammishtalleach, veechad baggoralot.
Uchevar amar "hashshem", venishma kolo biricho. amar rabba bar bar chana: mirushalayim liricho asara parsaot.

Vatzir daltot hahechol nishma bishmona techume shabbat. izzim shebbiricho hayu mitatteshot mereach hakketoret. nashim shebbiricho enan tzerichot lehitbassem mereach ketoret. kalla shebbirushalayim enah tzericha lehitkashshet mereach ketoret.

Amar rabbi (yose ben) dulegay: izzim hayu leabba behare (michmar), vehayu mitatteshot mereach hakketoret. amar rabbi chiyyay bar avin amar rabbi yehoshua ben korcha: sach li zaken echad, paam achat halachti leshilo, veherachti reach ketoret mibben kevtaleha.
Amar rabbi yannay: aliyyayt goral mittoch kalpi — meakkevet, hannacha — enah meakkevet. verabbi yochanan amar: af aliyyay enah meakkevet.

Allibba derabbi yehuda, deamar: devarim hannaasin bevigde lavan mibbachutz la meakkeva — kulle alma la peligi dela meakkeva. ki peligi allibba derabbi nechemya, man deamar meakkeva — kerabbi nechemya. uman deamar la meakkeva — hane mille avoda, hagerala lav avoda hi.
Ikka deamri,
Allibba derabbi nechemya deamar meakkeva — kulle alma la peligi dimakkeva,
Ki peligi allibba derabbi yehuda. man deamar la meakkeva — kerabbi yehuda, uman deamar meakkeva — shane hacha ditna beh kera: "asher ala", "asher ala", tere zimne.
Metivi: mitzva lehageril, veim lo higril kasher.
Bishlama lehach lishshana deamrat allibba derabbi yehuda kulle alma la peligi dela meakkeva, ha manni — rabbi yehuda hi.

a: Ella lehach lishshana deamrat peligi, bishlama leman deamar la meakkeva, ha manni — rabbi yehuda hi,
Ella leman deamar meakkeva, ha manni? teni: mitzva lehanniach.
Ta shema: mitzva lehageril ulehitvaddot. lo higril velo hitvadda — kasher. vechi tema hachi name lehanniach, ema sefa, rabbi shimon omer: lo higril — kasher, lo hitvadda — pasul.
May "lo higril"? illema lo hinniach, mikkelal derabbi shimon savar hagerala meakkeva, vehatanya: met echad mehen, mevi chavero shello bahagerala, divre rabbi shimon.
Rabbi shimon la yada may kaamri rabbanan, vehachi kaamar lehu: i hagerala — hagerala mammash ka amritu, peligna alayychu bachada. i hagerala dekaamritu hayeynu hannacha — peligna alayychu betarte.
Ta shema: par meakkev et hassair,
Vesair en meakkev et happar bemattanot shebbifnim.
Bishlama par meakkev et hassair: dei akdemeh lesair mikkamme par — la avad velo kelum. ella sair en meakkev et happar — may nihu?
Illema dei akdem mattanot defar bahechol mikkamme mattanot desair bifnim — "chukka" ketiv behu.
Ella lav, deakdem mattanot defar bifnim mikkamme hagerala. umiddesidra la meakkeva — (ikra) hagerala name la meakkeva!
La, deakdem mattanot defar bemizbeach mikkamme mattanot desair bahechol, verabbi yehuda hi, deamar: devarim hannaasin bevigde lavan bachutz — la meakkevi.
Veha bemattanot shebbifnim katane!
Ella: ha manni — rabbi shimon hi, deamar: hagerala la meakkeva.
Veibbaet ema: leolam rabbi yehuda hi, unehi dichsidra la meakkeva — hagerala miha meakkeva.
Veazdu letamayyhu, detanya:
b: "Yoomad chay lifne Adonai lechapper alav", ad matay yihye zakuk laamod chay? ad sheat mattan damo shel chavero — divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi shimon omer: ad sheat vidduy devarim.

Bemay ka mippalgi? kidtanya: "lechapper" — bechapparat damim hakkatuv medabber, vechen hu omer: "vechilla mikkapper et hakkodesh". ma lehallan — bechapparat damim, af kan — bechapparat damim, divre rabbi yehuda.
Rabbi shimon omer: "lechapper alav", bechapparat devarim hakkatuv medabber.
Ta shema, shaalu talmidav et rabbi akiva: ala bismol, mahu sheyyachazor leyamin? amar lahen: al tittenu makom lamminin lirdot.
Tama deal tittenu makom lamminin lirdot, ha lav hachi mahderinan leh, veha amrat hagerala meakkeva, vechevan dikvateh semol hechi mahderinan leh?
Amar rava, hachi kaamri: ala haggoral bismol, mahu sheyyachaziru lo velisiro leyamin. amar lahem: al tittenu makom lamminin lirdot.
Ta shema: illu neemar: "et hassair asher alav", hayiti omer yannichennu alav, — talmud lomar: "ala", kevan sheala shuv eno tzarich.
Lemay? ilema lemitzva, michlal dahanacha mitzva name la? ella lav, leakkev. ushema minna: hagerala meakkeva, hannacha — la meakkeva!
Amar rava, hachi kaamar: illu neemar "asher alav", hayiti omer yannichennu alav ad sheat shechita, talmud lomar: "asher ala", kevan sheala shuv eno tzarich.
Ta shema: "veasahu chattat", haggoral osehu chattat, veen hashshem osehu chattat.
Sheyyachol, vahalo din hu: uma bimkom shello kiddesh haggoral — kiddesh hashshem, mekom shekkiddesh haggoral, eno din sheyyekaddesh hashshem?
Talmud lomar: "veasahu chattat", haggoral ose chattat, veen hashshem ose chattat.

a: Setam sifra manni — rabbi yehuda, veka tane: haggoral ose chattat, veen hashshem ose chattat. alma hagerala meakkeva, teyuveta deman deamar hagerala la meakkeva. teyuveta.
Amar rav chisda: en hakkinnin mitparshot ella o bilkichat bealim, o baasiyyayt kohen.
Amar rav shimi bar ashe: may tama derav chisda, dichtiv: "velakcha" "veasa". o bilkicha, o baasiyyay.
Metivi: "veasahu chattat", haggoral ose chattat, veen hashshem ose chattat.
Sheyyachol, vahalo din hu: uma bimkom shello kiddesh haggoral — kiddesh hashshem, mekom shekkiddesh haggoral, eno din sheyyekaddesh hashshem?!
Talmud lomar: "veasahu chattat", haggoral ose chattat, veen hashshem ose chattat.
Veha hacha, delav sheat lekicha velav sheat asiyyay hi, vekatane dekava!

Amar rava, hachi kaamar: ma bimkom shello kiddesh haggoral vaafillu bishat lekicha, vaafillu bishat asiyyay — kiddesh hashshem bishat lekicha uvishat asiyyay, mekom shekkiddesh haggoral shello bishat lekicha veshello bishat asiyyay, eno din sheyyekaddesh hashshem bishat lekicha uvishat asiyyay?
Talmud lomar: "veasahu chattat", haggoral ose chattat, veen hashshem ose chattat.
Ta shema: metamme mikdash ani, vehifrish maot lekinno veheeshir, veachar kach amar: ellu lechattato, veellu leolato —
Mosif umevi chovato middeme chattato, veen mosif umevi chovato middeme olato.
Veha hacha, delav sheat lekicha velav sheat asiyyay hi, vekatane dekava!
Amar rav sheshet: vetisbera? vehaamar rabbi elazar amar rabbi hoshaya: metamme mikdash ashir vehevi korban ani — lo yatza, vechevan delo yatza hechi kava?
Ella may it lach lememar — shekkevar amar meaniyyuto, hacha name — shekkevar amar mishsheat haferasha.
Ulerabbi chagga amar rabbi yoshiyya, deamar yatza,
b: May ikka lememar? la tema: veachar kach amar, ella ema: veachar kach lakach veamar.
Lakach, mosif umevi chovato may nihu?!
Defarek leh. veha en pidyon laof!

Amar rav pappa: kegon shellakach pereda achat, i ola zevan — mosif umevi chovato middeme chattato, vehay ola azla lindava. i chattat zevan — en mosif umevi chovato middeme olato, vehay chattat azla lemita.
Gufa. amar rabbi elazar amar rabbi hoshaya: metamme mikdash ashir vehevi korban ani — lo yatza. verabbi chagga amar rabbi hoshaya: yatza.
Metivi: metzora ani shehevi korban ashir — yatza, ashir shehevi korban ani — lo yatza. shane hatam, dichtiv: "zot".
I hachi, resha name! ha rabbi rachamana "torat", vehatanya: "torat", lerabbot metzora ani shehevi korban ashir. yachol afillu ashir shehevi korban ani — talmud lomar: "zot".
Venelaf minna! miet rachamana "veim dal hu".
Mishna kashar lashon shel zehorit berosh sair hammishtalleach, veheemido keneged bet shillucho, velannishchat — keneged bet shechitato.

Ba lo etzel paro sheniyya, vesomech shete yadav alav umitvadde, vechach haya omer: ana hashshem! (chatati aviti ufashati) lefanecha ani uveti uvene aharon am kedoshecha. ana hashshem! kapper na laavonot velappeshaim velachataim sheaviti vesheppashati veshechatati lefanecha ani uveti uvene aharon am kedoshecha, kakkatuv betorat moshe avdecha: "ki vayyom hazze yechapper alechem letaher etchem mikkol chattotechem lifne Adonai titharu", vehen onin acharav: "baruch shem kevod malchuto leolam vead".
Gemara ibbaya lehu: "velannishchat" — akkeshira kae, o ahaamada kae?

Ta shema, detane rav yosef: kashar lashon shel zehorit berosh sair hammishtalleach, veheemido keneged bet shillucho, velannishchat — keneged bet shechitato, shello yitarev ze baze, velo yitarev baacherim.

I amrat bishlama akkeshira kae — shappir. ella i amrat ahaamada kae, nehi divchavreh la miarav, dehay ketir beh vehay la ketir beh, beacharine mihat miarav! ella lav, shema minna akkeshira kae. shema minna.
Amar rabbi yitzchak: shete leshonot shamati, achat shel para, veachat shel sair hammishtalleach. achat tzericha shiur, veachat enah tzericha shiur. vela yadana he minnayyhu.
Amar rav yosef, nichze anan: shel sair hammishtalleach devae chalukka — bae shiur, veshel para dela bae chalukka — la bae shiur.
Matkef la rame bar chama: defara name bae koved! amar leh rava: koved — tannae hi.
Udefara la bae chalukka?! etiveh abbaye: ketzad hu ose, korchan bishyare lashon! ema, biznav lashon.
Amar rabbi chanin amar rav: etz erez usheni tolaat shekkelatatan shalhevet — keshera. metivi: nithavhev hallashon — mevi lashon acher umekaddesh!
Amar abbaye, la kashya: kan bekolachat, kan benichpefet.
Rava omer: koved tannae hi. detanya: lamma korchan — kede sheyyihyu kullan baagudda achat, divre rabbi. rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer: kede sheyyehe bahen koved, veyippelu letoch serefat happara.

Ki ata rav dimi amar rabbi yochanan: shalosh leshonot shamati, achat shel para, veachat shel sair hammishtalleach, veachat shel metzora. achat mishkal asara zuz, veachat mishkal shene selaim, veachat mishkal shekel, veen li lefaresh.
Ki ata ravin, persha mishshemeh derabbi yonatan,

a: Shel para — mishkal asara zuz, veshel sair hammishtalleach — mishkal shene selaim, veshel metzora — mishkal shekel.
Amar rabbi yochanan: peligi ba rabbi shimon ben chalafta verabbanan befara, chad amar: mishkal asara, vechad amar: mishkal shekel. vesimanaych: "echad hammarbe veechad hammamit".

Amar leh rabbi yirmeya middifti leravina: la befara peligi, ella besair hammishtalleach peligi. vehahu yoma nach nafsheh deravya bar kisi, veannechu ba simana: ravya [bar] kisi mechapper kesair hammishtalleach.
Amar rabbi yitzchak: shete shechitot shamati, achat shel para, veachat shel paro. achat keshera bezar, veachat pesula bezar, vela yadana he minnayyhu.
Ittemar: shechitat para ufaro, rav ushemuel. chad amar: para pesula, paro keshera. vechad amar: paro pesula, para keshera.
Tistayyem derav hu deamar para pesula, deamar rabbi zera: shechitat para bezar pesula, veamar rav ala: "elazar" vechukka" shaninu bah.
Verav, may shena para — dichtiv "elazar" vechukka", paro name — ha ketiv "aharon" vechukka"!
Shechita lav avoda hi. i hachi para name! shane para, dekodshe bedek habbayit hi.
Velav kol dechen hu? amar rav shisha bereh derav idi: midde dehave ammarot negaim, delav avoda hi uvaaya kehunna.

Velishmuel, deamar paro pesula, may shena paro — dichtiv: "aharon" vechukka", para name — ha ketiv: "elazar" vechukka"? shane hatam, dichtiv: "veshachat otah lefanav", sheyyehe zar shochet veelazar roe.
Verav: shello yassiach dato mimmenna. ushemuel, shello yassiach dato mena leh? nafka leh: mivvesaraf et happara leenav".
Verav: chad bishchita vechad bisrefa.

Utzericha, dei ketav rachamana bishchita — mishshum ditchillat avoda hi, aval serefa — ema la, tzericha. vei ketav rachamana bisrefa — mishshum dehashta hu demittachshera para, aval shechita — ema la, tzericha.
Lemaote may? illema lemaote asifat efrah umilluy mayim lekiddush,
b: "Lemishmeret leme nidda" ketiv. ella lemaote hashelachat etz erez veezov usheni tolaat, delav gufa defara ninhu.
Ittemar: shechitat para bezar, rabbi amme amar: keshera, verabbi yitzchak nappacha amar: pesula. ulla amar: keshera, veamri la: pesula.
Metiv rabbi yehoshua bar abba lesayyoeh lerav: en li ella hazzaat memeha sheen kesherin baishsha kevaish, veen kesherin ella bayyom.

Minnayin lerabbot shechitatah vekabbalat damah vehazzaat damah userefatah vehashelachat etz erez veezov usheni tolaat — talmud lomar: "tora". yachol sheani merabbe af asifat efrah umilluy mayim vekiddush — talmud lomar: "zot".

Uma raita lerabbot et ellu, ulehotzi et ellu? achar sheribba hakkatuv umiet, amrat: hare anu lemedin kullan mehazzaat memeha, ma hazzaat memeha enan kesherin baishsha kevaish, veen kesherin ella bayyom — af ani avi shechitatah vekabbalat damah, vehazzaat damah userefatah, vehashelachat etz erez veezov usheni tolaat
Hoil veen kesherin baishsha kevaish — en kesherin ella bayyom. umotzi ani asifat efrah umilluy mayim vekiddush, hoil uchesherin baishsha kevaish — kesherin name bayyom uvallayla.
Vehay may teyuveta? illema middifsulin baishsha pesulin name bezar, hazzaat memeha tochiach, sheppesulin baishsha uchesherin bezar!
Amar abbaye, hayeynu teyuveteh: ishsha may tama? "elazar" — velo ishsha, zar name: "elazar" — velo zar.
Amar ulla: kol happarasha kullah, mashma motzi miyyad mashma, umashma mimmela.
"Unetattem otah el elazar hakkohen" — otah leelazar, velo ledorot leelazar. ikka deamri: ledorot bechohen gadol, veikka deamri: ledorot bechohen hedyot.
Bishlama leman deamar ledorot bechohen hedyot — shappir. ella leman deamar ledorot bechohen gadol, mena leh? gamar "chukka" "chukka" miyyom hakkippurim.

"Vehotzi otah" — shello yotzi acheret immah. keditnan: lo hayta para rotza latzet — en motziin immah shechora, shello yomru shechora shachatu. veen motziin immah adumma, shello yomru shetayim shachatu. rabbi omer: lo min hashshem hu ze, ella mishshum shenneemar: "otah", levaddah.
Vetanna kamma: ha ketiv "otah"? man tanna kamma — rabbi shimon hi, dedaresh tameh dikra. may benayyhu? ikka benayyhu,

a: Deappek chamor bahada.
"Veshachat otah" — shello yishchot acheret immah. "lefanav", lerav — shello yassiach dato mimmenna, lishmuel — sheyyehe zar shochet veelazar roe.
"Velakach elazar hakkohen middamah beetzbao", lishmuel — leahadoreh leelazar. lerav — have miut achar miut, veen miut achar miut ella lerabbot, daafillu kohen hedyot.
"Velakach hakkohen etz erez veezov usheni tolaat", lishmuel — daafillu bechohen hedyot. lerav — itzterich, salka datach amena: kevan delav gufa defara ninhu, la live kohen, ka mashma lan.
"Vechibbes begadav hakkohen" — bechihunno. "vetame hakkohen ad haarev" — kohen bechihunno ledorot.

Hanicha leman deamar ledorot bechohen hedyot — shappir, ella leman deamar ledorot bechohen gadol, hasheta kohen gadol baenan, bechihunno mibbaya?! in, milleta deatya bekal vechomer — tarach vechatav la kera.

"Veasaf ish tahor et efer happara vehinniach". "ish" — lehacheshir et hazzar, "tahor" — lehacheshir et haishsha, "vehinniach" — mi sheyyesh bo daat lehanniach, yatzu cheresh shote vekatan sheen bahen daat lehanniach.
Tenan hatam: hakkol kesherin lekaddesh, chutz mecheresh shote vekatan. rabbi yehuda machshir bekatan, ufosel beishsha uveanderoginos.
May tama derabbanan — dichtiv: "velakchu lattame meafar serefat hachattat". hanach difsali lach baasifa — pesali lach bekiddush, vehanach deachshari lach baasifa — achshari lach bekiddush.
Verabbi yehuda: im ken lema kera "velakach", may "velakchu" — daafillu katan difsali lach hatam, hacha — kasher.
Ishsha mena leh? "venatan", velo "venatna". verabbanan: i ketav rachamana: "velakach ... venatan", hava amena: ad deshakel chad veyahev chad, ketav rachamana: "velakchu".
Vei ketav rachamana "velakchu ... venatnu", hava amena: ad deshakli tere veyahavi tere, ketav rachamana: "velakchu ... venatan", daafillu shakli tere veyahev chad.
"Velakach ezov vetaval bammayim ish tahor", lerabbanan: ish velo ishsha. "tahor" — lehacheshir et hakkatan, ulerabbi yehuda: "ish" — velo katan, "tahor" — lehacheshir et haishsha.
Metivi: hakkol kesherin lehazzot, chutz mittumetum veanderoginos veishsha. vekatan (sheyyesh) bo daat, ishsha mesayyato umazze.
b: Vela pelig rabbi yehuda!
Amar abbaye: kevan deamar mar "mashma motzi miyyad mashma umashma mimmela" — pelig.
"Vehizza hattahor al hattame". "tahor" mikkelal shehu tame, limmed al tevul yom shekkasher befara.
Amar rabbi assi: ki havo ba rabbi yochanan veresh lakish befara, la masseki minna ella kemay demassek taala mibbe cherava. ella amri: "mashma motzi miyyad mashma umashma mimmela".
Tane tanna kammeh derabbi yochanan: kol hashshechitot kesherot bezar, chutz mishshel para. amar leh rabbi yochanan: pok teni levara: lo matzinu shechita bezar pesula.

Verabbi yochanan, la mibbaya letanna dela tzayet, ella afillu lerabbeh la tzayet. deamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yehotzadak: shechitat para bezar — pesula. vaani omer: keshera, lo matzinu shechita sheppesula bezar.
Ba lo etzel paro sheniyya. may shena bevidduy rishon dela amar: "uvene aharon am kedoshecha", umay shena bevidduy sheni deamar: "uvene aharon am kedoshecha"?
Tana deve rabbi yishmael, kach hi middat haddin notenet: mutav yavo zakkay vichapper al hachayyayv, veal yavo chayyayv vichapper al hachayyayv.

Mishna shechato vekibbel bemizrak et damo, venotno lemi shehu memares bo al haroved harvii shebbahechol, kede shello yikrosh. natal machta veala lerosh hammizbeach, ufinna gechalim elach veelach, vechote min hameukkalot happenimiyyot, veyarad vehinnichah al haroved harvii shebbaazara.
Bechol yom haya chote beshel kesef umeare betoch shel zahav, vehayyom chote beshel zahav uvah haya machnis.

Bechol yom chote beshel arbaat kabbin umeare letoch sheloshet kabbin, vehayyom chote bishloshet kabbin uvah haya machnis. rabbi yose omer: bechol yom chote beshel sea umeare betoch sheloshet kabbin, vehayyom chote bishloshet kabbin uvah haya machnis.
Bechol yom hayta keveda, vehayyom kalla. bechol yom hayta yadah ketzara, vehayyom arukka. bechol yom hayta zehava yarok, vehayyom adom. divre rabbi menachem.
Bechol yom makriv peras beshacharit uferas ben haarbayim, vehayyom mosif melo chofnav. bechol yom hayta dakka, vehayyom dakka min haddakka.
Bechol yom kohanim olin bemizracho shel kevesh veyordin bemaaravo, vehayyom kohen gadol ole baemtza veyored baemtza. rabbi yehuda omer: leolam kohen gadol ole baemtza veyored baemtza.
Bechol yom kohen gadol mekaddesh yadav veraglav min hakkiyyor, vehayyom min hakkiton shel zahav. rabbi yehuda omer: leolam kohen gadol mekaddesh yadav veraglav min hakkiton shel zahav.
Bechol yom hayu sham arba maarachot, vehayyom chamesh, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yose omer: bechol yom shalosh, vehayyom arba. rabbi yehuda omer: bechol yom shetayim, vehayyom shalosh.
Gemara vehachtiv: "vechol adam lo yihye beohel moed"? amar rav yehuda: teni "shel hechol".
Tanu rabbanan: "vechol adam lo yihye beohel moed",

a: Yachol afillu baazara — talmud lomar: "beohel moed". en li ella beohel moed shebbammidbar, shilo uvet olamim minnayin? talmud lomar: "bakkodesh".
En li ella bishat haketara, bishat mattan damim minnayin? talmud lomar: "bevoo lechapper". en li ella bichnisato, bitziato minnayin? talmud lomar: "ad tzeto".

"Vechipper baado uvead beto uvead kol kehal yisrael", kapparato kodemet lechapparat beto, kapparat beto kodemet lechapparat echav hakkohanim, vechapparat echav hakkohanim kodemet lechapparat kol kehal yisrael.

Amar mar: en li ella bishat haketara. may mashma? amar rava, vechen amar rabbi yitzchak bar avdimi, vechen amar rabbi elazar, amar kera: "vechipper baado uvead beto uvead kol kehal yisrael", ezehu kappara sheshshava lo uleveto uleechav hakkohanim ulechol kehal yisrael — heve omer ze haketarat hakketoret.

Uketoret mechapperet? in, deha tane rabbi chananya: lamadnu liktoret shemmechapperet, shenneemar: "vayyitten et hakketoret vaychapper al haam", vetana deve rabbi yishmael: al ma ketoret mechapperet — al lashon hara. yavo davar shebbachashay, vichapper al maase chashay.

Tenan hatam: porshin mibben haulam velammizbeach bishat haketara. amar rabbi elazar: lo shanu ella bishat haketara dehechol, aval bishat haketara delifnay lifnim — mehechol parshi, mibben haulam velammizbeach la parshi.

Metiv rav adda bar ahava, veamri la kedi, rabbi yose omer: keshem shepporshin mibben haulam velammizbeach bishat haketara, kach porshin bishat mattan par kohen mashiach ufar helem davar shel tzibbur useire avoda zara.
Ha ma maala yesh ben hahechol leven haulam velammizbeach? ella, shebbahechol porshin ben bishat haketara uven shello bishat haketara, umibben haulam velammizbeach en porshin ella bishat haketara.
Bishat haketara miha parshi. may lav, bishat haketara delifnay lifnim?

La, bishat haketara dehechol. i hachi, ha "ma maala" vetu la, ha ikka ha maala: deillu mehechol parshi ben bishat haketara dideh, ben bishat haketara delifnay lifnim, veillu mibben haulam velammizbeach la parshi ella bishat haketara dehechol!
Ha katane: ella shebbahechol porshin ben bishat haketara uven shello bishat haketara, umibben haulam velammizbeach en porshin
b: Ella bishat haketara.

Veha ikka ha maala, deillu mehechol parshi ben bikdushsha dideh, ben bikdushsha delifnay velifnim, veillu mibben haulam velammizbeach la parshi ella bikdushsha dehechol! amar rava: shem perisha achat hi.
Amar mar: kach porshin bishat mattan par kohen mashiach, ufar helem davar shel tzibbur, useire avoda zara. mena lan? amar rabbi pedat: atya "kappara" "kappara" miyyom hakkippurim.
Amar rav acha bar ahava, shema minna: maalot deorayyta, vehachi gemiri lehu.
Dei salka datach derabbanan, may shena ben haulam velammizbeach? dilma mikkeru veayyli — mikkulla azara name nifreshu, dilma mikkeru veayyli!
Ben haulam velammizbeach, kevan dela mafsek midde — la minnachra milleta. azara, kevan deikka mizbeach hachitzon demafsek — minnachra milleta.
Amar rava, shema minna: kedushshat ulam vehechol chada milleta hi. dei salka datach shete kedushshot ninhu, ulam gufeh gezera, venekum venigzor gezera ligzera?!
La, ulam uven haulam velammizbeach chada kedushsha hi, hechol veulam shete kedushshot.
Bechol yom haya chote beshel kesef vechulei. may tama? hattora chasa al mamonan shel yisrael.
Vehayyom chote beshel zahav uvah haya machnis. may tama? mishshum chulesha dechohen gadol.
Bechol yom beshel arbaat kabbin vechulei. tana: nitpazzeru lo kav gechalim, mechabbedan laamma.
Tane chada: kav, vetanya iddach: kabbayim. bishlama hach detane kav — rabbanan. ella hach detane kabbayim, manni? la rabbanan vela rabbi yose!
Amar rav chisda: rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka hi, detanya: rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer: beshel kabbayim haya machnis.
Rav ashe amar: afillu tema rabbi yose, vehachi kaamar: bechol yom haya chote beshel sea midbarit, umeare letoch sheloshet kabbin yerushalmiyyot.
Bechol yom hayta keveda, vehayyom kalla. tana, bechol yom hayta gildah ave, vehayyom rach. bechol yom hayta ketzara, vehayyom arukka. may tama — kede shettehe zeroo shel kohen gadol mesayyayto.
Tana, bechol yom lo haya lah niashtik, vehayyom haya lah niashtik. divre ben hassegan.

Bechol yom haya zehavah yarok. amar rav chisda: shiva zehavim hen: zahav, vezahav tov, uzehav ofir, vezahav mufaz, vezahav shachut, vezahav sagur, uzehav parvayim. zahav vezahav tov, dichtiv: "uzehav haaretz hahiv tov". zehav ofir — deate meofir. zahav mufaz —

a: Sheddome lefaz. zahav shachut — shennitve kechut. zahav sagur — beshaa shenniftach kol hachanuyot nisgarot. zehav parvayim — sheddome ledam happarim.
Rav ashe amar: chamishsha hen, vechol chad vechad it beh zahav vezahav tov. tanya name hachi: bechol yom haya zehavah yarok, vehayyom adom — vehayeynu zehav parvayim sheddome ledam happarim.

Bechol yom makriv peras shacharit vechulei. bechol yom hayta dakka, vehayyom dakka min haddakka. tanu rabbanan: "dakka" ma talmud lomar? vahalo kevar neemar: "veshachakta mimmenna hadek"! ella, lehavi dakka min haddakka.
Bechol yom kohanim olin bemizracho shel kevesh. deamar mar: kol pinnot sheatta pone lo yehu ella derech yamin lammizrach.
Vehayyom (olin) baemtza (veyordin) baemtza. may tama — mishshum kevodo dechohen gadol.
Bechol yom kohen [gadol] mekaddesh yadav veraglav min hakkiyyor vechulei. may tama — mishshum kevodo shel kohen gadol.

Bechol yom hayu sham arba maarachot. tanu rabbanan: bechol yom hayu shetayim maarachot, vehayyom shalosh. achat maaracha gedola, veachat maaracha sheniyya shel ketoret, veachat shemmosifin bo bayyom, divre rabbi yehuda.
Rabbi yose omer: bechol yom shalosh, vehayyom arba. achat shel maaracha gedola, veachat maaracha sheniyya shel ketoret, veachat shel kiyyum haesh, veachat shemmosifin bo bayyom.

Rabbi (meir) omer: bechol yom arba, vehayyom chamesh. achat shel maaracha gedola, veachat shel maaracha sheniyya shel ketoret, veachat shel kiyyum haesh, veachat leevarim ufedarim shello nitakkelu mibbaerev, veachat shemmosifin bo bayyom.

Dechulle alma mihat tarte it lehu, menalan? amar kera: "hi haola al mokda al hammizbeach kol hallayla" — zo maaracha gedola. "veesh hammizbeach tukad bo" — zo maaracha sheniyya shel ketoret. verabbi yose, kiyyum haesh mena leh? nafka leh: mivvehaesh al hammizbeach tukad bo".

Verabbi yehuda: hahu, lehatztzatat alita hu daata. detanya, haya rabbi yehuda omer: minnayin lehatztzatat alita shello tehe ella berosho shel mizbeach? talmud lomar: "vehaesh al hammizbeach tukad bo". amar rabbi yose: minnayin sheose maaracha lekiyyum haesh? talmud lomar: "vehaesh al hammizbeach tukad bo".

Verabbi yose, hatztzatat alita mena leh? nafka leh mehecha denafka leh lerabbi shimon. detanya: "venatnu bene aharon hakkohen esh al hammizbeach" — limmed al hatztzatat alita shello tehe ella bechohen kasher uvichli sharet, divre rabbi yehuda. amar lo rabbi shimon: vechi taale al datecha shezzar karev legabbe mizbeach? ella, limmed al hatztzatat alita shello tehe ella berosho shel mizbeach.
Verabbi yehuda? i mehatam, hava amena: kae aara veaved bemappucha, ka mashma lan.
Verabbi meir, evarim ufedarim shello nitakkelu mibbaerev, mena leh? nafka leh: mivveesh". verabbanan — vav la darshi.
Verabbanan, evarim ufedarim shello nitakkelu mibbaerev may aved lehu? mahdar lehu lemaaracha gedola. detanya: minnayin leevarim ufedarim shello nitakkelu mibbaerev
b: Shessodran al gabbe mizbeach, veim en machazikan, shessodran al hakkevesh o al gabbe sovev, ad sheyyaase maaracha gedola, vesodran? talmud lomar: "asher tochal haesh et haola al hammizbeach".

Verabbi meir: ikkule ola atta machazir, vei atta machazir ikkule ketoret. detane rabbi chananya bar minyome bidve rabbi eliezer ben yaakov: "asher tochal haesh et haola al hammizbeach" — ikkule ola atta machazir, vei atta machazir ikkule ketoret.
Dechulle alma mihat mosifin bo bayyom it lehu. mana lehu? nafka lehu: mivvehaesh". vaafillu leman dela daresh vav, vav he daresh.
"Esh tamid" lemay ata? mibbee leh lechidtanya: "esh tamid tukad al hammizbeach lo tichbe" — limmed al maaracha sheniyya shel ketoret shello tehe ella al hammizbeach hachitzon.
Esh machta umenora minnayin? vedin hu: neemra esh biktoret, veneemra esh bemachta umenora — ma lehallan al mizbeach hachitzon, af kan al hammizbeach hachitzon.
O kelach lederech zo: neemra esh biktoret, veneemra esh bemachta umenora — ma lehallan besamuch lo, af machta umenora besamuch lo.
Talmud lomar: "esh tamid tukad al hammizbeach lo tichbe" — esh tamid sheamarti lach, lo tehe ella berosho shel mizbeach hachitzon.
Lamadnu esh lammenora, esh lammachta minnayin? vedin hu: neemra esh bemachta, veneemra esh bimnora — ma lehallan al gabbe mizbeach hachitzon, af kan al mizbeach hachitzon.
O kelach lederech zo: neemra esh biktoret, veneemra esh bemachta — ma lehallan besamuch lo, af kan besamuch lo!
Talmud lomar: "velakach melo hammachta gachale esh meal hammizbeach millifne Adonai", ezehu mizbeach shemmiktzato lifne Adonai veen kullo lifne Adonai — heve omer ze mizbeach hachitzon.

Veitzterich lemichtav: "meal hammizbeach", veitzterich lemichtav: "millifne Adonai", dei ketav rachamana "meal hammizbeach", hava amena: may "mizbeach" — mizbeach penimi, ketav rachamana: "millifne Adonai". vei ketav rachamana: "millifne Adonai", hava amena davka millifne Adonai,

a: Aval mehay gisa umehay gisa ema la, tzericha.
Amar rabbi elazar mishshum bar kappara, omer haya rabbi meir: evre ola shennittotru — ose lahen maaracha bifne atzmah vesodran, vaafillu beshabbat.
May ka mashma lan? tenena: bechol yom hayu sham arba maarachot. amar rabbi avin: lo nitzrecha ella lifsulin.
Vedavka shemmashla bahen haur, aval lo mashla bahen haur — lo.
Ikka deamri: echad kesherin veechad pesulin, i mashla bahen haur — in, vei la — la.
Vaafillu beshabbat — tenena: vehayyom chamesh!

Amar rav acha bar yaakov: itzterich, salka datach amena hane mille hecha dechal yom hakkippurim lihyot achar hashshabbat, dechelve shabbat kerevin beyom hakkippurim, aval beemtza shabbat — la, ka mashma lan.
Amar rava: man hay dela chayesh lekimcheh? ha "bechol yom" tenan! kashya.
Ufeliga derav huna, deamar: techillato docha, sofo eno doche.
Gufa. amar rav huna: tamid, techillato docha, sofo eno doche.
May eno doche? rav chisda amar: doche et hashshabbat, veeno doche et hattumea. (verava) amar: doche et hattumea, veeno doche et hashshabbat.
Amar leh abbaye (lerava): ledidach kashya, ulerav chisda kashya. ledidach kashya: may shena tumea, dichtiv "bemoado" — vaafillu betumea, shabbat name — "bemoado", vaafillu beshabbat!
Ulerav chisda kashya: may shena shabbat, dichtiv "bemoado" — afillu beshabbat, tumea name — "bemoado", vaafillu betumea?
Amar leh: la ledidi kashya, vela lerav chisda kashya. ledidi la kashya: sofo kitchillato,
b: Tumea, ditchillato bar midche tumea hu — sofo name dache. shabbat, ditchillato lav bar midche shabbat hu — sofo name la dache.
Lerav chisda la kashya: sofo kitchillato (techillato) let leh. shabbat dehuttera hi betzibbur — sofo name dache.
Tumea, didchuya hi betzibbur, techillato deikkar kappara — dache, sofo delav ikkar kappara — la dache.
Ittemar: hamechabbe esh machta umenora, abbaye amar: chayyayv, rava amar: patur.
Dechabbeyay berosho shel mizbeach, dechulle alma la peligi dechayyayv. ki peligi deachatay aara vechabbeyay. abbaye amar: chayyayv, esh hammizbeach hu, rava amar: patur, kevan denatteka — natteka.
Ella ha deamar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: hammorid gachelet meal gabbe hammizbeach vechibbah chayyayv, keman? keabbayye!
Afillu tema kerava, hatam la innetik lemitzvata, hacha innetika lemitzvata.
Ikka deamri.
Deachatay aara vechabbeyay, dechulle alma la peligi defatur. ki peligi, dechabbeyyay berosho shel mizbeach, abbaye amar: chayyayv, esh hammizbeach hu, rava amar: patur, kevan denatteka — natteka.
Ella ha deamar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: hammorid gachelet meal gabbe hammizbeach vechibbah — chayyayv, keman? la keabbayye vela kerava! hatam la innetik lemitzvata, hacha innetik lemitzvata.
Hadaran alach taraf bakkalpi

a: Hotziu lo et hakkaf veet hammachta, chafan melo chofnav venatan letoch hakkaf. haggadol lefi godlo, vehakkatan lefi kotno. vechach hayta middatah. natal et hammachta bimino veet hakkaf bismolo.

Gemara machta? tena leh: natal et hammachta veala lerosh hammizbeach vechote veyored! hatam machta degechalim, vehacha machta diktoret, detanya: hotziu lo kaf rekan millishkat hakkelim, umachta gedusha shel ketoret millishkat bet avtinas.
Chafan melo chofnav venoten letoch hakkaf. haggadol — lefi godlo, vehakkatan — lefi kotno. vechach hayta middatah. kaf beyom hakkippurim lema li? "melo chofnav vehevi" amar rachamana!
Mishshum dela efshar, dehechi nebed? neayyel vahadar neayyel — havaa achat amar rachamana, vela shete havaot.

Nishkelay liktoret bechofnav venachatay [lemachta] ala veleul. ki mate hatam hechi laaved? nishkelay beshinneh venachatay lemachta? hasheta lifne melech basar vedam en osin ken, lifne melech malche hammelachim hakkadosh baruch hu — al achat kamma vechamma.
Hilkach — la efshar, vechevan dela efshar — avdinan kidashkechan binsiim.
Natal et hammachta beyamin veet hakkaf bismol. yatztziva beara vegiyyora bishme shemayya!
Zo merubba, vezo muetet. vaafillu bizman sheshshenehen shavin, uchemaase derabbi yishmael ben kimchit, zo — chamma, vezo — tzonenet.

Amru alav al rabbi yishmael ben kimchit shehaya chofen arbaat kabbin bimlo chofnav, veomer: kol hannashim [zered] zardu, vezered imma ala laggag. ikka deamri: bearsan, vechidrabba bar yonatan. deamar rabba bar yonatan amar rabbi yechiel: arsan yafe lachole.

Veikka deamri beshichvat zera, vechidrabbi avahu. derabbi avahu rame, ketiv: "vattazreni [chayil] lammilchama", uchetiv: "hameazzereni chayil"? amar david lifne hakkadosh baruch hu: ribbono shel olam! zeritani vezeraztani.

Amru alav al rabbi yishmael ben kimchit: paam achat sipper devarim im aravi echad bashshuk, venitteza tzinnora mippiv al begadav. venichnas yeshevav achiv veshimmesh tachtav. veraata imman shene kohanim gedolim beyom echad.

Veshuv amru alav al rabbi yishmael ben kimchit: paam achat yatza vesipper im hegmon echad bashshuk, venitteza tzinnora mippiv al begadav. venichnas yosef (im) achiv veshimmesh tachtav, veraata imman shene kohanim gedolim beyom echad.

Tanu rabbanan: shiva banim hayu lah lekimchit, vechullan shimmeshu bichhunna gedola. amru lah chachamim: ma asit shezzachit lechach? amra lahem: miyyamay lo rau korot beti kale seari. amru lah: harebe asu ken velo hoilu.
Tanu rabbanan: bekumetzo, shello yaase midda lakkometz. ibbaya lehu: mahu sheyyaase midda lachafina?
Hatam hu dichtiv "bekumetzo": aval hacha dela ketiv "bechofnav", ella: "melo chofnav ketoret sammim dakka", la. o dilma yalef "melo" "melo" mikkumetzo?
Ta shema: "vechach hayta middatah", may lav, sheim ratza laasot midda acheret ose? lo, hachi kaamar: vechach haya chozer vechofnah lifnim.
Shamat minna: chofen vechozer vechofen!
Dilma: sheim ratza laasot midda — ose. i name: shello yechasser veshello yotir.

Tanu rabbanan: "melo kumetzo". yachol mevoratz — talmud lomar: "bekumetzo". i bekumetzo, yachol afillu berashe etzbeotav, talmud lomar: "melo kumetzo", kidkamtzi inashe. ha ketzad — chofe shelosh etzbeotav al pissat yado vekometz.
b: Uvemachavat uvemarcheshet, mochek begudalo millemala, uveetzbao ketanna millematta. vezo hi avoda kasha shebbammikdash. zo hi vetu la? veha ikka melika, veha ikka chafina! ella: zo hi meavodot kashot shebbammikdash.
Amar rabbi yochanan, bae rabbi yehoshua ben uzzaa: ben habbenayim shel melo kumetzo, mahu? amar rav pappa: degavvay la tibbee lach — devadday kometz hu. devaray la tibbee lach — devadday shirayim hu.
Ki tibbee lach devene bene may. amar rabbi yochanan: hadar pashta yehoshua [ben] uzzaa: ben habbenayim safek ninhu.

Hechi aved? amar rabbi chanina: maktir kometz lechodeh techilla, vahadar ben habbenayim. dei amrat ben habbenayim beresha — dilma shirayim ninhu vehavu lehu shirayim shechasru ben kemitza [lehaketara], veamar mar: shirayim shechasru ben kemitza lehaketara en maktirin alehen et hakkometz.
I hachi, hasheta name ikkeri kan: kol shemmimmennu laishshim — hare hu beval taktiru.
Amar rabbi yehuda bereh derabbi shimon ben pazzi: demakter leh leshum etzim, kerabbi eliezer. detanya, rabbi eliezer omer: "lereach nichoach" i atta maale, aval atta maale leshum etzim.
Hanicha lerabbi eliezer, ella lerabbanan may ikka lememar? amar rav mari: dekamtzi shammine. hasheta deatet lehachi, rabbi eliezer name lechattechilla dekamtzi shammine.

(Ben habbenayim, pashat, umachatz, ufizzer, vechishshev, bachafinat chavero — siman). bae rav pappa: ben habbenayim shel melo chofnav mahu? may ka mibbaya leh? i gamar "melo" "melo" mehatam — hayeynu hach!
Rav pappa hachi bae leh: "melo chofnav vehevi" baenan — veha ikka, o dilma: "velakach" "vehevi" baenan — veha lekka? teku.
Amar rav pappa: peshita li melo kumetzo kidkamtzi inashe. bae rav pappa: kamatz berashe etzbeotav, mahu?
Millematta lemala, mahu? min hatztzedadin, mahu? teku.

Amar rav pappa: peshita li "melo chofnav" kidchafni inashe. bae rav pappa: chafan berashe etzbeotav, mahu? millematta lemala, mahu? min hatztzad, mahu? chafan bezo uvazo vekervan zo etzel zo, mahu? teku.
Bae

a: Rav pappa: dabbekeh lekometz bedufeneh demana, may? toch keli baenan — veha ikka, o dilma: hannacha betocho ketikno baenan — veha lekka. teku.
Bae mar bar rav ashe: afcheh lemana vedabbekeh lekometz beariteh demana, mahu? hannacha betocho baenan — veha ikka, o dilma hannacha ketikno bainan — velekka? teku.
Bae rav pappa: melo chofnav sheamru — mechukot, o gedushot? amar leh rabbi abba lerav ashe, ta shema: melo chofnav sheamru — lo mechukot, velo gedushot, ella tefufot.
Tenan hatam: nishpach haddam al haritzpa vaasafo pasul. min hakkeli al haritzpa vaasafo — kasher.
Mena hane mille? tanu rabbanan: "velakach middam happar", middam hannefesh, velo middam haor, velo middam hattamtzit.

"Middam happar", dam mehappar yekabbelennu, dei salka datach "middam happar" — "middam", vaafillu miktzat dam, vehaamar rav yehuda: hamekabbel, tzarich sheyyekabbel et kol damo shel par, shenneemar: "veet kol dam happar yishpoch el yesod mizbach".
Ella shema minna: may "middam happar" — dam mehappar yekabbelennu. vekasavar: gorin umosifin vedorshin.
Bae rav pappa: nitpazzer hakketoret mimmelo chofnav, mahu? yado ketzavvar behema dame — ufesula, o dilma kichli sharet dame — vela pesula? teku.
Bae rav pappa: chishshev bachafinat ketoret, mahu? mi amrinan yalef "melo" "melo" mimmincha, ma hatam mahneya ba machshava, hacha name mahneya ba machshava, o lo?
Amar leh rav shimi bar ashe lerav pappa: ta shema: hosif rabbi akiva (hakkometz) vehakketoret, vehallevona, vehaggechalim, sheim naga tevul yom bemiktzatan — pasal et kullan.
Ka salka datach: middefasal tevul yom — pasla name lina. umiddelina pasla — pasla name machshava.
Bae rav pappa:
b: Chishshev bachatiyyayt gechalim, mahu? machshire mitzva kemitzva damu, o la? teku.
Beo minneh merav sheshet: holacha bismol, mahu? amar lehu rav sheshet, tenetuha: natal et hammachta bimino veet hakkaf bismolo.
Venifshot lehu meha ditnan: haregel shel yamin bismol uvet orah lachutz!
I mehatam, hava amena: hane mille holacha dela meakkeva kappara, aval holacha dimakkeva kappara — la, kamashma lan.

a: Metivi: zar, veonen, shikkor, uvaal mum, bekabbala uveholacha uvizrika — pasul. vechen yoshev, vechen semol — pasul! teyuveta.

Veha rav sheshet hu deotva, daamar leh rav sheshet leamoreh derav chisda, bei minneh merav chisda: holacha bezar mahu? amar leh: keshera, umikra mesayyeyeni: "vayyishchatu happasach vayyizreku hakkohanim miyyadam vehaleviyyim mafshitim"!
Umotev rav sheshet: zar veonen, shikkor uvaal mum, bekabbala uveholacha uvizrika — pasul, vechen yoshev vechen semol — pasul.
Batar deshama hadar otva. veha rav chisda kera kaamar? daavud maase itzteva.
Bae rav pappa: chafan chavero, venatan letoch chofnav mahu? "melo chofnav" baenan, veha ikka! o dilma: "velakach" "vehevi" baenan? veha lekka! teku.
Bae rabbi yehoshua ben levi: chafan vamet, mahu sheyyikkanes acher bachafinato? amar rabbi chanina: bo uree sheelat harishonim.
Lememra derabbi yehoshua ben levi kashshish? vehaamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: li hittir rabbi chanina lishtot shachalayim beshabbat!
Lishtot, peshita? ditnan: kol haochalin ochel adam lirfua, vechol hammashkin shote!

Ella: lishchok velishtot shachalayim beshabbat. hechi dame? i deikka sakkanta — mishra shere. vei delekka sakkanta — mesar asir! leolam deikka sakkanta, vehachi ka mibbaya leh: mi masseya, denechul alayyhu shabbeta, o la masseya vela nechul alayyhu shabbeta.
Umay shena rabbi chanina? mishshum devaki birfuot hu. deamar rabbi chanina: meolam lo shealani adam al makkat pirda levana vechaya.
Veha ka chazenan dechayye! ema: vechayayt. veha ka chazenan demittassi! besummakan inhu vechivvaran resh karayhu kaamrinan.
Mikkol makom, shema minna derabbi chanina kashshish? ella hachi kaamar: sheelatan kishela shel rishonim.
Ume amar rabbi chanina hachi? vehaamar rabbi chanina: "befar", velo bedamo shel par.
Veamar rabbi chanina: ketoret shechafanah kodem shechitat happar lo asa velo chelum!
Hachi kaamar: middeka mibbaya leh, ha mikkelal dekasavar "befar", vaafillu bedamo shel par. ulemay disvira leh — sheilato kishelat harishonim.
May have ala? amar rav pappa: i chofen chozer vechofen — chavero nichnas bachafinato — deha mikkayyma chafina. i en chofen vechozer vechofen — tibbee lach.

Amar leh rav huna bereh derav yehoshua lerav pappa: adderabba, i chofen vechozer vechofen, lo yikkanes acher bachafinato — i efshar shello yechasser veshello yotir. vei en chofen chozer vechofen — tibbee lach.
Deibbaya lehu: chofen chozer vechofen, o la? ta shema: kach hayta middatah. may lav: keshem shemmiddatah mibbachutz kach middatah mibbifnim!
La, dilma sheim ratza laasot midda — ose, i name: shello yechasser veshello yotir.
Ta shema:
b: Ketzad hu ose? ochez et habbazech berosh etzbeotav, veyesh omrim beshinnav, umaale begudalo ad shemmaggaat leven atztzile yadav, vechozer umachzirah letoch chofnav, vetzovrah, kede sheyyehe ashanah shohe lavo. veyesh omrim: mefazzerah, kede sheyyehe ashanah memaheret lavo.
Vezo hi avoda kasha shebbammikdash. zo hi vetu la? veha ikka melika! veha ikka kemitza! ella: zo hi avoda kasha meavodot kashot shebbammikdash. shema minna: chofen vechozer vechofen. shema minna.
Ibbaya lehu: shachat vamet, ma hu sheyyikkanes acher bedamo? mi amrinan: "befar" — vaafillu bedamo shel par, o dilma: "befar" — velo bedamo shel par.

Rabbi chanina omer: "befar" — velo bedamo shel par, veresh lakish amar: "befar" — vaafillu bedamo shel par. rabbi amme amar: "befar" — velo bedamo shel par, rabbi yitzchak amar: "befar" — vaafillu bedamo shel par.
Etiveh rabbi amme lerabbi yitzchak nappacha: nimnin umoshchin yedehen mimmennu ad sheyyishshachet, veim ita — "ad sheyyizrok" mibbee leh!
Shane hatam, dichtiv: "mihyot misse" — mechayyute dese.
Metiv mar zutera: veen podin — lo baegel velo bechayya velo bishchuta velo bitrefa velo bechilayim velo bechoy, ella bese. shane hatam, deyalef "se" "se" mippesach.
I ma lehallan zachar tam uven shana, af kan zachar tam uven shana? talmud lomar: "tifde" "tifde" ribba.
I "tifde" "tifde" ribba, afillu kullehu name! im ken, "se" may ahani leh?

a: Etiveh rabbi yitzchak nappacha lerabbi amme: "vehotzi et kol happar"! sheyyotzi et kullo.
"Veet par hachattat veet seir hachattat", amar rav pappa: beor uvasar vaferesh dechulle alma la peligi. ki peligi bedam. mar savar: dam ikkeri par, umar savar: dam la ikkeri par.
Amar rav ashe: mistabbera keman deamar dam ikkeri par, dichtiv: "bezot yavo aharon el hakkodesh befar ben bakar", attu bekarneh meayyel leh?! ella bedamo, vekare leh "par".
Veiddach? bamma hucheshar aharon lavo el hakkodesh — befar ben bakar lechattat.
Vetippok leh dechattat shemmetu bealeha hi, vechattat shemmetu bealeha lemita azla! amar leh ravin bar rav adda lerava: amri talmidaycha, amar rav amram: chattat tzibbur hi, vela lemita azla.
Ditnan, amar lo rabbi meir: vahalo par yom hakkippurim, vachavitte kohen gadol, ufesach — dekarban yachid hu, vedoche et hashshabbat veet hattumea. lav mikkelal deikka leman deamar detzibbur?

Uletamaych, dekatane: amar lo rabbi yaakov: vahalo par helem davar shel tzibbur, useire avoda zara, vachagiga — dekarban tzibbur, veen dochin lo et hashshabbat velo et hattumea! mikkelal deikka leman deamar deyachid!

Ella: letanna kamma ka mahdar leh, deshameh dekaamar: korban tzibbur doche et hashshabbat veet hattumea, vekarban yachid eno doche lo et hashshabbat velo et hattumea. amar lo rabbi meir: korban yachid kelala hu? vahalo par yom hakkippurim, vachavitte kohen gadol, ufesach — dekarban yachid hu, vedochin et hashshabbat veet hattumea!
Veamar lo rabbi yaakov: korban tzibbur kelala hu? vahalo par helem davar shel tzibbur, useire avoda zara, vachagiga — dekarban tzibbur hu, veen dochin lo et hashshabbat velo et hattumea!

Ella, nekot hay kelala bidach: kol shezzemanno kavua — doche et hashshabbat veet hattumea afillu beyachid, vechol sheen zemanno kavua — eno doche lo et hashshabbat velo et hattumea vaafillu betzibbur.

Etiveh abbaye: par vesair shel yom hakkippurim sheavdu, vehifrish acherim tachtehen — kullam yamutu. vechen seire avoda zara sheavdu, vehifrish acherim tachtehen — kullam yamutu, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi (eliezer) verabbi shimon omrim: yiru ad sheyyistaavu veyimmachru veyippelu demehen lindava, sheen chattat tzibbur meta.
Amar leh: may par — par helem davar shel tzibbur. veha "shel yom hakkippurim" katane! ki katane — addesair.

Vehatanya: par shel yom hakkippurim vesair shel yom hakkippurim sheavdu vehifrish acherim tachtehen — kullam yamutu, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi (eliezer) verabbi shimon omrim: yiru ad sheyyistaavu veyimmachru veyippelu demehen lindava, sheen chattat tzibbur meta.
La tema: "sheen chattat tzibbur meta", ella ema: "sheen chattat hashshuttafin meta". umay nafka minna?
Dela mayytu kohanim par behoraa.
Ta shema, devae rabbi (eliezer):
b: Ledivre haomer par yom hakkippurim korban yachid, ose temura o eno ose temura. lav mikkelal deikka leman deamar detzibbur?
La, mikkelal deikka leman deamar deshuttafin.
Gufa. bae rabbi (eliezer): ledivre haomer par yom hakkippurim korban yachid, ose temura o eno ose temura. may ka mibbaya leh?
I batar makdish azlinan, i batar mitkapper azlinan.
Peshita devatar mitkapper azlinan, deamar rabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan: hammakdish — mosif chomesh, vehammitkapper — ose (bah) temura.
Vehattorem mishshello al shel chavero — tovat hanaa shello!
Leolam peshita leh devatar mitkapper azlinan, vehachi ka mibbaya leh: echav hakkohanim bikviuta mitkapperi, o dilma bekufeya mitkapperi.
Ta shema: chomer bezevach mibbitmura, vechomer bitmura mibbezevach. chomer bezevach: shehazzevach noheg beyachid kivtzibbur, vedoche et hashshabbat veet hattumea, veose temura — ma sheen ken bitmura.
Chomer bitmura mibbezevach: shehattemura chala al baal mum kavua, veenah yotza lechullin liggazez veleaved — ma sheen ken bezevach.

Hay zevach hechi dame? illema deyachid — mi dache shabbat vetumea? ella detzibbur — mi ose temura? ella lav defar, vedoche et hashshabbat veet hattumea — dikvia leh zeman, veose temura — dekarban yachid hu.
Amar rav sheshet: la, beelo shel aharon.
Hachi name mistabbera, dei salka datach defaro, temura defar shabbat vetumea hu dela dachaya, ha bechol mikrav karva?! ha temurat chattat hi, utemurat chattat lemita azla!
La, leolam paro. umay temura — shem temura.
I hachi, zevach name — shem zevach? shem zevach la katane.
Mimmay — middekatane: chomer bitmura, shehattemura chala al baal mum kavua, veenah yotza lechullin liggazez veleaved. vei salka datach: may zevach — shem zevach, veha ikka

a: Bechor umaaser, dechalin al baal mum kavua, veen yotzin lechullin liggazez veleaved. ella shem zevach la katane.
Umay shena? temura — shem temura achat hi. zevach — ikka bechor veikka maaser.
Ulerav sheshet, addemokem la beelo shel aharon, lokma befesach, dedoche et hashshabbat veet hattumea veose temura, dekorban yachid hu? kasavar: en shochatin happesach al hayyachid.
Venokmeh befesach sheni! mi dache tumea?

Amar leh rav huna bereh derav yehoshua lerava: vetanna, may shena pesach dekare leh korban yachid, umay shena chagiga dekare la korban tzibbur? i mishshum deate bechinnufeya — pesach name ate bechinnufeya? ikka pesach sheni dela ate bechinnufeya.

Amar leh: im ken yehe doche et hashshabbat veet hattumea! amar leh: in, keman deamar dache, detanya: pesach sheni doche et hashshabbat, veeno doche et hattumea. rabbi yehuda omer: af doche et hattumea. may tama detanna kamma — amar lach: mippene tumea dechito veyease betumea?!
Verabbi yehuda amar lach, amar kera: "kechol chukkat happesach yaasu oto", vaafillu betumea. hattora hechzira alav laasoto betohora, lo zacha — yaasennu betumea.
b: Vetippok li daasher lo" amar rachamana — mishshello hu mevi.

Detanya: "asher lo" — mishshello hu mevi, velo mishshel tzibbur. yachol lo yavi mishshel tzibbur — sheen hatztzibbur mitkapperin bo, aval yavi mishshel echav hakkohanim — shehare echav hakkohanim mitkapperim bo, talmud lomar: "asher lo".
Yachol lo yavi, veim hevi kasher — talmud lomar shuv: "asher lo" — shana hakkatuv alav leakkev.

Velitamaych, echav hakkohanim i lav dekanu begavveh hechi mechappar lehu? ella shane be gazza deaharon deafkereh rachamana gabbe echav hakkohanim. hacha [gabbe temura] name: shane be gazza deaharon deafkereh rachamana gabbe echav hakkohanim.

Mishna haya mehallech bahechol ad shemmaggia leven shete happarochot hammavdilot ben hakkodesh uven kodesh hakkodashim, uvenehen amma. rabbi yose omer: lo hayta sham ella parochet achat bilvad, shenneemar: "vehivdila happarochet lachem ben hakkodesh uven kodesh hakkodashim".

Gemara shappir kaamar lehu rabbi yose lerabbanan! verabbanan amri lecha: hane mille bemishkan, aval bemikdash sheni kevan dela havay amma teraksin, uvemikdash rishon hu dahavay, veistappaka lehu lerabbanan bikdushsheteh, i kelifnim i kelachutz, vaavud shete parochot.

Tanu rabbanan: ben hammizbeach lammenora haya mehallech, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi meir omer: ben shulchan lammizbeach. veyesh omrim: ben shulchan lakkotel. man yesh omrim? amar rav chisda: rabbi yose hi, deamar: pitcha betzafon kae.
Verabbi yehuda amar lach: pitcha bedarom kae. verabbi meir keman sevira leh? i kerabbi yehuda sevira leh — neul kerabbi yehuda, i kerabbi yose sevira leh — neul kerabbi yose!
Leolam kerabbi yose sevira leh, vaamar lecha: shulechanot tzafon vedarom munnachin, umafseka leh shulchan vela mitayyel leh.
Veibbaet ema: leolam mizrach umaarav munnachin, umishshum shechina lav orach ara

a: Lemeal lehedya. verabbi yose amar lach: chavivin yisrael shello hitzrichan hakkatuv leshaliach.
Verabbi yehuda name, neul ben menora lechotel! mashchari maneh.
Amar rabbi natan: amma teraksin, lo hichriu bo chachamim i kelifnim i kelachutz.

Matkef la ravina: may tama? illema mishshum dichtiv: "vehabbayit asher bana hammelech shelomo laAdonai shishshim amma orko veesrim rochbo usheloshim amma komato", uchetiv: "vearbaim baamma haya habbayit hu hahechol lifnay", uchetiv: "velifne haddevir esrim amma orech veesrim amma rochav veesrim amma komato", vela yadinan amma teraksin i mehane esrim, vei mehane arbaim.
Vedilma la mehane esrin vela mehane arbein, vachalala ka chashev, kevtalim la ka chashev. tidda, dechol hecha deka chashev kevtalim — chashev leh ledideh,

Ditnan: hahechol mea al mea berum mea. kotel ulam chamesh, vehaulam achat esre, kotel hahechol shesh, veorko arbaim amma, veamma teraksin, veesrim amma bet kodshe hakkodashim, kotel hahechol shesh, vehatta shesh, vechotel hatta chamesh.
Ella kedushsheteh i kelifnim i kelachutz.
Vehayeynu deamar rabbi yochanan, bae yosef ish hutzal: "udevir betoch habbayit mippenima hechin letitten sham et aron berit Adonai". ibbaya lehu: hechi kaamar kera:
"Udevir betoch habbayit mippenima hechin letitten sham", o dilma hachi kaamar: "udevir betoch habbayit mippenima"?
Umi mesappeka leh? vehattanya, isi ben yehuda omer: chamesh mikraot battora en lahen hechrea:
b: "Seet".
"Meshukkadim".
"Machar".
"Arur".
"Vekam".

Vehatanya: hu yosef ish hutzal, hu yosef habbavli, hu isi ben yehuda, hu isi ben gur arye, hu isi ben gamliel, hu isi ben mahalalel, uma shemo — isi ben akiva shemo. bidorayyta — lekka, bedinvie — ikka.

Uvidorayyta lekka? veha ikka devae rav chisda: "vayyishlach et naare bene yisrael vayyaalu olot kevasim vayyizbechu zevachim shelamim parim" — o dilma idde veidde parim! lerav chisda mesappeka leh, leisi ben yehuda peshita leh.

Mishna hachitzona hayta perufa min haddarom, ufenimit min hatztzafon. mehallech benehen, ad shemmaggia latztzafon. higgia latztzafon — hofech panav laddarom, mehallech lismolo im happarochet ad shehu maggia laaron,

Higgia laaron — noten et hammachta ben shene habbaddim. tzavar et hakketoret al gabbe gechalim, venitmalle kol habbayit kullo ashan. yatza uva lo bederech bet kenisato, umitpallel tefilla ketzara babbayit hachitzon. velo haya maarich bitfillato, shello lehaveit et yisrael.
Gemara bemay askinan? ilema bemikdash rishon, mi havo parochet? ella bemikdash sheni, mi hava aron?

Vehatanya: mishshennignaz aron — nigneza immo tzintzenet hamman, utzelochit shemen hammishcha, umaklo shel aharon ushekedeha uferacheha, veargaz sheshshiggeru pelishtim doron lelohe yisrael, shenneemar: "uchele hazzahav asher hashevotem lo asham tasimu vaargaz mitztziddo veshillachtem oto vehalach".
Umi genazo — yoshiyyahu genazo. ma raa sheggenazo? raa shekkatuv: "yolech Adonai otcha veet malkecha asher takim alecha", amad ugenazo.

Shenneemar: "vayyomer lalviyyim hammevinim lechol yisrael hakkedoshim laAdonai tenu et aron hakkodesh babbayit asher bana shelomo ven david melech yisrael en lachem massa bakkatef atta ivdu et Adonai elohechem veet ammo yisrael".
Veamar rabbi elazar: atya "shamma" "shamma", veatya "dorot" "dorot".
Veatya "mishmeret" "mishmeret".
Leolam bemikdash sheni, umay "higgia laaron" — mekom aron. veha katane: natan et hammachta leven shene habbaddim! ema: "keven shene habbaddim".
Tzavar et hakketoret al gabbe gechalim. tenan keman deamar tzovrah. tane chada: tzovrah penima shehi chutza lo. vetanya iddach: tzovrah chutza shehi penima lo.
Amar abbaye: tannae hi. veamar abbaye: mistabbera keman deamar penima shehi chutza lo — ditnan, melammedin oto: hizzaher

a: Shello tatchil mippanecha, shemma tikkave.
Tanu rabbanan: "venatan et hakketoret al haesh lifne Adonai" — shello yetakken mibbachutz veyachnis. lehotzi millibban shel tzaddukin, sheomrim yetakken mibbachutz veyachnis.
May derush? "ki beanan erae al hakkapporet" — melammed sheyyetakken mibbachutz veyachnis.
Amru lahem chachamim, vahalo kevar neemar: "venatan et hakketoret al haesh lifne Adonai". im ken, ma talmud lomar: "ki beanan erae al hakkapporet" —

Melammed shennoten bah maale ashan. uminnayin shennoten bah maale ashan? shenneemar: "vechissa anan hakketoret et hakkapporet". ha lo natan bah maale ashan, o shechissar achat mikkol sammaneha — chayyayv mita.
Vetippok leh — deka meayyel bia rekanit!
Amar rav sheshet: hacha bemay askinan, kegon sheshshagag bevia, vehezid behaketara.

Rav ashe amar: afillu tema hezid bezo uvazo, uchegon deayyel shete haketarot, achat shelema veachat chasera. abbia la michayyayv — deha ayyel leh shelema, ahaktara — michayyayv, deka maktar ketoret chasera.
Amar mar: uminnayin shennoten bah maale ashan, talmud lomar: "vechissa". kera likra?
Amar rav yosef, hachi kaamar: en li ella ale maale ashan, ikkar maale ashan minnayin? talmud lomar: "vechissa".

Amar leh abbaye: veha ippecha tanya! detanya: natan bah ikkar maale ashan, haya mittammer veole kemakkel ad shemmaggia lishme kora. kevan shehiggia lishme kora, memashmesh veyored bakkotalim ad shennitmalle habbayit ashan, shenneemar: "vehabbayit yimmale ashan"!
Ella amar abbaye, hachi kaamar: en li ella ikkar maale ashan, ale maale ashan minnayin? talmud lomar: "vechissa".
Rav sheshet amar: en li ella ohel moed shebbammidbar. shilo uvet olamim minnayin? talmud lomar: "vechissa".
Hay, mivvechen yaase leohel moed hashshochen ittam" nafka!
Ella hachi kaamar: en li ella beyom hakkippurim. bishar yemot hashshana minnayin? talmud lomar: "vechissa".
Rav ashe amar: chad lemitzva, vechad leakkev. rava amar: chad leonesh, vechad leazhara.
Tanya, rabbi eliezer omer: "velo yamut" — onesh, "ki beanan erae" — azhara.

Yachol yihyu shenehem amurin kodem mitat bene aharon — talmud lomar: "achare mot shene bene aharon". yachol yihyu shenehem amurim achar mitat shene bene aharon — talmud lomar: "ki beanan erae al hakkapporet". ha ketzad? azhara kodem mita, veonesh achar mita.
May talmuda? amar rava, amar kera: "ki beanan erae" — vaadayin lo nira. veella may tama ianush?

Kidtanya, rabbi eliezer omer: lo metu bene aharon ella al shehoru halacha bifne moshe rabban. may derush? "venatnu bene aharon hakkohen esh al hammizbeach" — af al pi shehaesh yoredet min hashshamayim, mitzva lehavi min hahedyot.

Yatza uva lo derech kenisato. mena hane mille? amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani, amar rabbi yonatan, amar kera: "vayyavo shelomo labbama asher begivon yerushalam", vechi ma inyan givon etzel yerushalayim?

Ella: makkish yetziato miggivon lirushalayim, leviato mirushalayim legivon: ma biato mirushalayim legivon — panav kelappe vama, kederech biato, af yetziato miggivon lirushalayim — panav kelappe vama, kederech biato.
Vechen kohanim baavodatan, uleviyyim beduchanan, veyisrael bemaamadan, keshehen niftarin — lo hayu machazirin penehen veholchin, ella metzaddedin penehen veholchin.

Vechen talmid hanniftar merabbo lo yachazir panav veyelech, ella metzadded panav veholech. ki ha derabbi elazar kad hava mippetar minneh derabbi yochanan, kad hava bae rabbi yochanan lesaggoye, hava gachen kae rabbi elazar adducheteh ad dahava mikkasse rabbi yochanan minneh.

Vechad hava bae rabbi elazar lesaggoye, hava ka azel laachoreh ad demikkasse minneh derabbi yochanan. rava kad hava mippetar minneh derav yosef, hava azel laachoreh ad deminnaggefan kareh umittavvevsan iskuppata deve rav yosef dema.
b: Amaru leh lerav yosef: hachi aved rava. amar leh: yehe raava ditrum reshach akkulle karka.

Amar rabbi alekkesanderi amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: hammitpallel, tzarich sheyyafsia shalosh pesiot laachorav, veachar kach yitten shalom. amar leh rav mardochay: kevan sheppasa shalosh pesiot laachorav — hatam ibbaya leh lemekam. mashal letalmid hanniftar merabbo, im chozer lealtar, dome lechelev sheshshav al kio.

Tanya name hachi: hammitpallel, tzarich sheyyafsia shalosh pesiot laachorav veachar kach yitten shalom, veim lo asa ken rauy lo shello hitpallel. umishshum shemaya amru: shennoten shalom leyamin, veachar kach lismol, shenneemar: "mimino esh dat lamo", veomer: "yippol mitztziddecha elef urevava miminecha".
May veomer? vechi tema orcha demilleta hi lemittav beyamin, ta shema: "yippol mitztziddecha elef urevava miminecha".

Rava chazyeh leabbaye deyahev shelama leyammina beresha amar leh: mi savrat limin didach? lismol didach ka amena, dehave yemino shel hakkadosh baruch hu. amar rav chiyyay bereh derav huna: chazena lehu leabbaye verava defasi lehu shalosh pesiot bichria achat.

Umitpallel tefilla ketzara babbayit hachitzon. may metzalle? rava bar rav adda veravin bar rav adda tarvayyhu mishshemeh derav amri: yehi ratzon millefanecha Adonai elohenu shettehe shana zo geshuma ushechuna. shechuna mealleyuta hi?! ella ema: im shechuna tehe geshuma.

Rav acha bereh derava mesayyem ba mishshemeh derav yehuda: la yide aved shuletan middevet yehuda, velo yihyu ammecha yisrael tzerichin lefarnasa ze mizze, velo tikkanes lefanecha tefillat ovre derachim.

Rabbi chanina ben dosa hava ka azel beorcha. sheda mitra aleh, amar: ribbono shel olam! kol haolam kullo benachat, vachanina betzaar. pesak mitra. ki ata leveteh, amar: ribbono shel olam! kol haolam kullo betzaar, vachanina benachat. ata mitra. amar rav yosef: may ahneya leh tzeloteh dechohen gadol legabbe rabbi chanina ben dosa.

Tanu rabbanan: maase bechohen gadol echad sheheerich bitfillato, venimnu echav hakkohanim likkanes acharav. hitchilu hem nichnasin vehu yotze. amru lo: mippene ma heerachta bitfillatecha? amar lahem: kashe beenechem shehitpallalti alechem veal bet hammikdash shello yecharev? amru lo: al tehi ragil laasot ken, shehare shaninu: lo haya maarich bitfillato kede shello lehaveit et yisrael.

Mishna mishshennittal aron, even hayta sham mimot neviim rishonim, ushetiyyay hayta nikret, gevoha min haaretz shalosh etzbaot vealeha haya noten. natal et haddam mimmi shehaya memares bo, nichnas lammakom shennichnas, veamad bammakom sheamad, vehizza mimmennu achat lemala vesheva lematta.

Velo haya mitkavvevn lehazzot lo lemala velo lematta ella kematzlif. vechach haya mone: achat, achat veachat, achat ushetayim, achat veshalosh, achat vearba, achat vechamesh, achat veshesh, achat vasheva. yatza vehinnicho al kan hazzahav shebbahechol.

Heviu lo et hassair, shechato, vekibbel bemizrak et damo, nichnas lammakom shennichnas, veamad bammakom sheamad, vehizza mimmennu achat lemala vesheva lematta, vechach haya mone: achat, achat veachat, achat ushetayim vechulei. yatza vehinnicho al kan hazzahav hashsheni shebbahechol. rabbi yehuda omer: lo haya sham ella ken echad bilvad. natal dam happar vehinniach dam hassair,

Vehizza mimmennu al happarochet shekkeneged haaron mibbachutz, achat lemala vesheva lematta velo haya mitkavvevn vechulei. vechach haya mone vechulei. natal dam hassair vehinniach dam happar, vehizza mimmennu al happarochet shekkeneged haaron mibbachutz, achat lemala vesheva lematta vechulei. era dam happar letoch dam hassair, venatan et hammale barekan.

Gemara "mishshennignaz" la katane, ella "mishshennittal". tenan keman deamar aron gala levavel. detanya, rabbi eliezer omer: aron gala levavel, shenneemar: "velitshuvat hashshana shalach hammelech nevuchadnetztzar vayviehu vavela im kele chemdat bet Adonai".
Rabbi shimon ben yochay omer: aron gala levavel, shenneemar: "lo yivvater davar amar Adonai" — ellu aseret haddibberot shebbo.
Rabbi yehuda (ben lakish) omer: aron bimkomo nignaz, shenneemar: "vayyerau rashe habbaddim min hakkodesh al pene haddevir velo yerau hachutza vayyihyu sham ad hayyom hazze".

Ufeliga deulla. deamar ulla, shaal rabbi matya ben charash et rabbi shimon ben yochay beromi: vechi meachar sherabbi eliezer melammedenu paam rishona usheniyya: aron gala levavel, rishona ha daamaran: "vayviehu vavela im kele chemdat bet Adonai", sheniyya may hi? — dichtiv: "vayyetze mibbat tziyyon

a: Kol hadarah". may: "kol hadarah" — chadrah. atta, may atta omer? amar lo, sheani omer: aron bimkomo nignaz, shenneemar: "vayyaarichu habbaddim vegomer".

Amar leh rabba leulla: may mashma? dichtiv: "vayyihyu sham ad hayyom hazze", vechol hecha dichtiv: "ad hayyom hazze" leolam hu? vehachtiv: "veet hayevusi yoshev yerushalam lo horishu bene vinyamin vayyeshev hayevusi et bene vinyamin birushalam ad hayyom hazze", hachi name dela gelo?

Vehatanya, rabbi yehuda omer: chamishshim ushetayim shana lo avar ish bihuda, shenneemar: "al heharim essa vechi vanehi veal neot midbar kina ki nitztzetu mibbeli ish over velo shamu kol mikne meof hashshamayim vead behema naddu halachu", "behema" begimatriyya chamshin ushetayim havu!

Vetanya, rabbi yose omer: sheva shanim nitkayyeyma gofrit umelach beeretz yisrael. veamar rabbi yochanan: may tama derabbi yose — atya "berit" "berit". ketiv hacha: "vehigbir berit larabbim shavua echad", uchetiv hatam: "veamru al asher azvu et berit Adonai elohe avotam"!

Amar leh: hacha ketiv "sham", hatam la ketiv "sham", vechol hecha dichtiv: "sham" — leolam hu. metivi: "umehem min bene shimon halchu lehar seir anashim chamesh meot ufelatya unearya urefaya veuzziel bene yishi berosham. vayyakku et sheerit happeleta laamalek vayyeshvu sham ad hayyom hazze".
Uchevar ala sancheriv melech ashshur uvilbel kol haaratzot, shenneemar: "veasir gevulot ammim vaatudotehem shoseti". teyuveta.

Amar rav nachman: tana, vachachamim omrim: aron belishkat dir haetzim haya ganuz. amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: af anan name tenena: maase bechohen echad shehaya mitassek, veraa ritzpa meshunna mechavroteha, uva vehodia et chavero, velo hispik ligmor et haddavar ad sheyyatzta nishmato. veyadu beyichud sheshsham aron ganuz.

May hava aved? amar rabbi chelbo: mitassek bekardummo haya. tana deve rabbi yishmael: shene chohanim baale mumin hayu matliin beetzim, venishmeta kardummo shel echad mehem venafla sham, veyatzta esh vaachalattu.

Rav yehuda rame. ketiv: "vayyerau rashe habbaddim", uchetiv: "velo yerau hachutza". ha ketzad? nirin veen nirin. tanya name hachi: "vayyerau rashe habbaddim", yachol lo yehu zazin mimmekoman — talmud lomar: "vayyaarichu habbaddim", yachol yehu mekarin bapparochet veyotzin — talmud lomar: "velo yerau hachutza".
Ha ketzad? dochakin uvoltin veyotzin bapparochet, venirin kishne dadde ishsha, shenneemar: "tzeror hammor dodi li ben shaday yalin".

Amar rav kattina: beshaa shehayu yisrael olin laregel, megallelin lahem et happarochet, umarin lahem et hakkeruvim shehayu meorim ze baze, veomrim lahen: rau chibbatchem lifne hammakom kechibbat zachar unekeva.
Metiv rav chisda: "velo yavou lirot kevalla et hakkodesh", veamar rav yehuda amar rav: bishat hachenasat kelim lenartek shellahem!
Amar rav nachman: mashal lechalla, kol zeman shehi bevet aviha tzenua mibbalah. kevan shebbata levet chamiha — enah tzenua mibbalah.
Metiv rav chana bar rav kattina: maase bechohen echad shehaya mitassek vechulei! amar leh: nitgarsha ka amrat, nitgarsha chazru lechibbatah harishona.
Bemay askinan? i nema bemikdash rishon — mi havay parochet? ella bemikdash sheni — mi havo keruvim? leolam bemikdash rishon, umay parochet — parochet devave.

Deamar rabbi zera amar rav: shelosha asar parochot hayu bemikdash, shiva keneged shiva shearim, shetayim — achat lefitcho shel hechol, veachat lefitcho shel ulam. shetayim baddevir, ushetayim kenegdan baaliyya.

Rav acha bar yaakov amar: leolam bemikdash sheni, ucheruvim detzureta havo kayymi, dichtiv: "veet kol kirot habbayit mesav kala keruvim vetimorot ufeture tzitztzim vetzippa zahav meyushshar al hammechukke".
Uchetiv: "kemaar ish veloyot". may "kemaar ish veloyot"? amar rabba bar rav shela:
b: Keish hameore ballevayay shello. amar resh lakish: beshaa shennichnesu goyim lahechol rau keruvim hameorin ze baze, hotziun lashshuk veamru: yisrael hallalu, shebbirchatan beracha vekillatan kelala — yaasku bidvarim hallalu? miyyad hizzilum, shenneemar: "kol mechabbedeha hizziluha ki rau ervatah".

Ushetiyya hayta nikret. tana: shemmimmenna hushetat haolam. tenan keman deamar mitztziyyon nivra haolam, detanya, rabbi eliezer omer: olam meemtzaito nivra, shenneemar: "betzeket afar lammutzak uregavim yedubbaku".

Rabbi yehoshua omer: olam min hatztzedadin nivra, shenneemar: "ki lashsheleg yomar heve aretz vegeshem matar vegeshem mitrot uzzo". rabbi yitzchak (nappacha) amar: even yara hakkadosh baruch hu bayyam, mimmennu nishtat haolam, shenneemar: "al ma adaneha hotbau o mi yara even pinnatah".
Vachachamim omrim: mitztziyyon nivra, shenneemar: "mizmor leasaf el elohim Adonai". veomer: "mitztziyyon michlal yofi" — mimmennu muchelal yofyo shel olam.

Tanya, rabbi eliezer haggadol omer: "elle toldot hashshamayim vehaaretz behibbaram beyom asot Adonai elohim eretz veshamayim", "toldot shamayim" — mishshamayim nivreu, "toldot haaretz" — meeretz nivreu.

Vachachamim omrim: ellu vaellu mitztziyyon nivreu, shenneemar: "mizmor leasaf el elohim Adonai dibber vayyikra aretz mimmizrach shemesh ad mevoo". veomer: "mitztziyyon michlal yofi elohim hofia" — mimmennu muchelal yofyo shel olam.
Natal et haddam mimmi shemmemares bo vechulei. may kematzlif? machve rav yehuda —
