a: Kimnaggedana. tana, keshehu mazze — eno mazze al hakkapporet, ella keneged ovyah shel kapporet. keshehu mazze lemala — metzadded yado lematta. ucheshehu mazze lematta — metzadded yado lemala.
Mena hane mille? amar rav acha bar yaakov, amar rabbi zera, amar kera: "vehizza oto al hakkapporet velifne hakkapporet", lo yomar "lematta" besair, dela tzerich, degamar mimmatta defar,
Lamma neemar — leakkoshe "al" lelifne": ma "lifne" delav al, af "al" delav al.
Adderabba: lo yeamer "lemala" befar dela tzerich, degamar mimmala desair. lamma neemar? leakkoshe "lifne" leal": ma "al" — al mammash, af "lifne" — al mammash!

Hay may?! i amrat bishlama lematta desair leakkoshe lemala defar — mibbee leh lechidtana deve rabbi eliezer ben yaakov. detana deve rabbi eliezer ben yaakov: "al pene hakkapporet kedma" — ze bana av: kol makom shenneemar "pene" eno ella kadim. ella i amrat lemala defar leakkoshe lematta desair — lemay ata?
Tanu rabbanan: "vehizza oto al hakkapporet velifne hakkapporet" — lamadnu: kamma lemala bassair — achat. lematta bassair, eni yodea kamma!
Hareni dan: neemru damim lematta bappar, veneemru damim lematta bassair. ma lematta bappar — sheva, af lematta bassair — sheva.

O kelach lederech zo: neemru damim lemala bassair, veneemru damim lematta bassair. ma lemala bassair — achat, af lematta bassair — achat? nire lemi dome: danin matta mimmatta, veen danin matta milmala.

Adderabba, danin gufo miggufo, veen danin gufo mealma! talmud lomar: "veasa et damo kaasher asa ledam happar", sheen talmud lomar "kaasher asa", uma talmud lomar "kaasher asa" — sheyyihyu kol asiyyotav shavot. keshem shellematta bappar — sheva, kach lematta bassair — sheva.

Lamadnu kamma lematta? bappar uvassair — sheva. lemala bappar eni yodea kamma, vahareni dan: neemru damim lemala bassair, veneemru damim lemala bappar. ma lemala bassair — achat, af lemala bappar — achat.
O kelach ladderech zo: neemru damim lematta bappar, veneemru damim lemala bappar. ma lematta bappar — sheva, af lemala bappar — sheva! nire lemi dome? danin mala mimmala, veen danin mala mimmatta!

Adderabba: danin gufo miggufo, veen danin gufo mealma! talmud lomar: "veasa et damo kaasher asa", sheen talmud lomar "kaasher asa", uma talmud lomar "kaasher asa"? sheyyihyu kol asiyyotav shavot, keshem shellematta bappar — sheva, kach lematta bassair — sheva. ucheshem shellemala bassair — achat, kach lemala bappar — achat.

Achat, achat veachat, achat ushetayim. tanu rabbanan: achat, achat veachat, achat ushetayim, achat veshalosh, achat vearba, achat vechamesh, achat vashesh, achat vasheva, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: achat, achat veachat, shetayim veachat, shalosh veachat, arba veachat, chamesh veachat, shesh veachat, sheva veachat.
Vela peligi: mar ki atreh umar ki atreh.
Dechulle alma mihat hazzaa rishona tzericha minyan im kol achat veachat, may tama? rabbi elazar amar: shello yite bahazzaot.
Rabbi yochanan amar, amar kera: "velifne hakkapporet yazze", sheen talmud lomar "yazze", uma talmud lomar "yazze"? limmed al hazzaa rishona shetztzericha minyan im kol achat veachat.
May benayyhu? ikka benayyhu delo mana velo taa.
Yatza vehinnicho al kan hazzahav shebbahechol. tenan hatam: rabbi yehuda omer: lo hayu shofarot lekinne chova, mippene hattaarovot.
May mippene hattaarovot? amar rav yosef: mippene taarovet chova bindava. amar leh abbaye: venaaved tere venichtov alayyhu he dechova vehe dindava? rabbi yehuda
b: Let leh ketiva. ditnan, rabbi yehuda omer: lo haya sham ella kan echad bilvad. tere may tama la — mishshum demichallefi. venaaved tere velichtov alayyhu he defar vehe desair. ella, lerabbi yehuda let leh ketiva.
Metivi: shelosh esre shofarot hayu bemikdash, vehaya katuv alehen: tiklin chadtin, vetiklin attikin, vekinnin, vegozle ola, veetzim, ulevona, vezahav lechapporet, veshishsha lindava.

Tiklin chadtin — ellu shekalim shel kol shana veshana, tiklin attikin — mi shello shakal eshtakad, yishkol leshana habbaa. kinnin — hen torin, gozle ola — hen bene yona, vechullan olot, divre rabbi yehuda.
Ki ata rav dimi, amar: amri bemareva, gezera mishshum chattat shemmetu bealeha. umi chayyshinan? vehatnan: hashsholeach chattato mimmedinat hayyam — makrivin otah bechezkat shehu kayyaym!
Ella: mishshum chattat shemmetu bealeha vadday. venivror arbaa zuze venishde bemayya, vehanach nishtero? rabbi yehuda let leh berera.
Mena lan? illema meha ditnan: hallokeach yayin mibben hakkutiyyim, erev shabbat im chashecha — omed veomer: shene luggin sheani atid lehaferish hare hen teruma.

a: Asara maaser rishon, tisha maaser sheni, umechel veshote miyyad. divre rabbi meir.
b: Rabbi yehuda verabbi yose verabbi shimon osrin. alma en berera.
Mimmay? dilma shane hatam kidkatane tama, amru lo lerabbi meir: i atta mode shemma yibbaka hannod venimtza shote tevalim lemafrea? veamar lahem: lichsheyyibbaka.
Ella, middetane ayyo. detane ayyo, rabbi yehuda omer: en adam matne al shene devarim keechad.
Ella: im ba chacham lammizrach — eruvo lammizrach. lammaarav — eruvo lammaarav. aval lechan ulechan — la.
Vehavenan ba: may shena lechan ulechan dela, deen berera.
Lemizrach umaarav name en berera?
Veamar rabbi yochanan: keshekkevar ba chacham.
Vehasheta deamrinan lerabbi yehuda en berera, ha ketiva it leh! yom hakkippurim name, naaved tere venichtov alayyhu!
Mishshum chulesha dechohen gadol lav addateh. dei la tema hachi, bela ketiva name, hay nefish vehay zutar.
Vechi tema la mekabbel leh kulleh, vehaamar rav yehuda: hashshochet tzarich sheyyekabbel et kol damo shel par, shenneemar: "veet kol dam happar yishpoch el yesod hammizbeach".
Vechi tema: dilma mishtefich minneh — hay chivvar vehay summak. ella, mishshum chulesha dechohen gadol lav addateh. hacha name, mishshum chulesha dechohen gadol lav addateh.
Hahu dinchet kammeh derava, amar: yatza vehinnicho al kan sheni shebbahechol, natal dam happar, vehinniach dam hassair.
Amar leh: chada kerabbanan vachada kerabbi yehuda?! ema: hinniach dam hassair, venatal dam happar.
Vehizza mimmennu al happarochet keneged aron mibbachutz. tanu rabbanan: "vechen yaase leohel moed", ma talmud lomar? keshem shemmazze lifnay lefanim — kach mazze bahechol.

Ma lifnay lifnim, achat lemala vesheva lematta middam happar — kach mazze bahechol. ucheshem shellifnay lifnim, achat lemala vesheva lematta middam hassair — kach mazze bahechol. "hashshochen ittam betoch tumeotam", afillu bishat shehen temeim — shechina immahem.
Amar leh hahu tzadduki lerabbi chanina:

a: Hasheta bari temeim attun, dichtiv: "tumeatah beshuleha". amar leh, ta chazi ma ketiv behu: "hashshochen ittam betoch tumeotam", afillu bizman shehen temein — shechina sheruya benehen.
Vechi davar hallamed behekkesh, chozer umelammed behekkesh?
Hay, hemennu vedavar acher hu, vela have hekkesh.
Hanicha leman deamar la have hekkesh. ella leman deamar have hekkesh, may ikka lememar?
Mekomot hu degamri mehadade.
I baet ema: chutz mibbifnim bachada zimna gamar.
Tana: keshehu mazze, eno mazze al happarochet, ella keneged happarochet. amar rabbi elazar berabbi yose: ani reitiha beromi, vehayu aleha kamma tippe damim shel par vesair shel yom hakkippurim.
Vedilma defar helem davar shel tzibbur useire avoda zara havo!
Dachaza daavidi kesidran. utenan name gabbe par helem davar shel tzibbur ki hay gavvna: keshehu mazze, lo hayu nogin bapparochet, veim nagu — nagu.

Amar rabbi elazar berabbi yose: ani reitiha beromi, vehayu aleha kamma tippe damim shel par helem davar shel tzibbur, useire avoda zara. vedilma defar vesair shel yom hakkippurim ninhu? dachazanhu daavidi shello kesidran.
Nitarvu lo damim bedamim, amar rava: noten achat lemala vesheva lematta, veole lo lechan ulechan.

Amruha kammeh derabbi yirmeya, amar: bavlae tafshae, mishshum dedayyri beara dachashocha — amri shemata dimchashshechan! ha ka yahev lemala desair mikkamme matta defar, vehattora amra: "vechilla mikkapper et hakkodesh", kalle dam happar veachar kach kalle dam hassair!
Ella, amar rabbi yirmeya: noten achat lemala vesheva lematta leshem happar, vechozer venoten achat lemala vesheva lematta leshem hassair.
Nitarvu lo damim bedamim bemattanot haacharonot, sevar rav pappa kammeh derava lememar: noten sheva lematta leshem par uleshem sair, vechozer venoten achat lemala leshem sair.

Amar leh rava: ad hasheta karu lan tafshae, vehasheta — tafshae detafshae, deka magmerinan lehu vela gemiri. veha ka yahev matta desair mikkamme mala desair, vehattora amra: ten lemala, veachar kach lematta!
b: Ella amar rava: noten sheva lematta leshem par, vechozer venoten achat lemala vesheva lematta leshem sair.
Nitarvu lo kosot bechosot — noten, vechozer venoten,
Vechozer venoten, shelosha peamim.
Miktzat damim nitarvu lo, umiktzat damim lo nitarvu [lo], peshita: ki yahev — mivvaddain yehev.
Mihu, hanach: shirayim havu, velisod azli, o dilma: dechuyin havu, veazli leamma?
Amar rav pappa: afillu leman deamar kos echad ose chavero shirayim — hane mille hecha dei bae lemetav matze yahev. aval hay, dei bae lemetav la matze yahev — la.
Amar leh rav huna bereh derav yehoshua lerav pappa: adderabba: afillu leman deamar kos echad ose chavero dachuy — hane mille, dedachyeh beyadayim, aval hecha dela dachyeh beyadayim — la.
Detanya, lemala hu omer: "veet damo yishpoch", ulematta hu omer: "veet kol damah yishpoch".
Minnayin lechattat shekkibbel dama bearba kosot venatan mizze achat umizze achat, shekkullan nishpachin layyesod — talmud lomar: "veet kol damah yishpoch".

Yachol afillu natan arba mattanot meachat mehen — talmud lomar: "veet damo yishpoch" — hahu nishpach layyesod, vehen nishpachin laamma. rabbi eliezer berabbi shimon omer: minnayin lechattat shekkibbel dama bearba kosot venatan arba mattanot meechad mehen, shekkullan nishpachin layyesod — talmud lomar: "veet kol damah yishpoch".
Ulerabbi eliezer berabbi shimon, ha ketiv: "veet damo yishpoch"? amar rav ashe: lemaote shirayim shebbetzavvar behema.
Era dam happar letoch dam hassair. tenan keman deamar: mearvin likranot. deittemar: rabbi yoshiyya verabbi yonatan, chad amar: mearvin, vechad amar: en mearvin.
Tistayyem derabbi yoshiyya hu deamar mearvin, deamar: af al gav dela ketiv "yachdav" — keman dichtiv "yachdav" dame.
Afillu tema rabbi yonatan hu, shane hacha dichtiv: "achat".
Tanya dela keshinnuyayn: "velakach middam happar umiddam hassair", sheyyihyu meoravin, divre rabbi yoshiyya.
